chapters.title: Chapter 33 - Dali Is Healthy
paragraphs: Following Hong Weiguo’s words, the entire Hongwu Villa erupted.

The old butler changed to a new outfit—a washed and starched snow-white shirt, a black knot-tie, a well-ironed black Chinese tunic suit, well-ironed black pants, and a pair of shiny black leather shoes. Coupled with his seemingly never-bending body, he was commanding all the manpower available. “All of you, listen up! Young Master Dali’s body condition has turned for the better. Master plans to celebrate today! Whoever messes up can just pack your luggage and leave!

“The tulip there has already withered, change a new pot! The curtain over there doesn’t match with the overall coloration. Change it for a dark-red one to look more festive. Have the ceiling lights been cleaned? Pay attention to the blind spots at the back.
“Damn it, who cleaned this table, why is there an oil stain on it? Get a clean cloth and wipe it repeatedly, do you hear me!”
As the butler of the entire Hongwu Villa, an elite groomed from Heavenly State’s aristocratic family of butlers, his piercing eyes could pick out any discrepancy.

At this moment, Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi were inside the study room on the third floor. This was the most important room in the entire villa. In addition to countless books and documents, there was also a large blackboard that was filled with seemingly balderdash languages.

If an outsider were to see this, they would not even waste time glancing at this large blackboard, because everything else in this study room was worth much more than this thing that shouldn’t belong here.

Only the core members of the Hong family knew that this blackboard was worth more than 10 times the entire villa added up. The reason was simple: all of Hong Weiguo’s sudden inspirations and ideas to make money would be written on this blackboard. From 22 years old, when he had started enterprising all the way till today, the ideas on this blackboard had earned him at least 15 billion yuan. The actual value would only be more than this, not less.

It was not an exaggeration to say that any group of Chinese characters on this blackboard, if seen by someone with the intention and capability to decipher Hong Weiguo’s true ideas, coupled with a suitable amount of capital, would be sufficient for one to live the rest of their life very comfortably. Maybe even their next life and their next next life would not have to worry about money.
This was the true value of this blackboard.

But now, without any hesitation, Hong Weiguo held up the blackboard eraser, cleared a space of one square meter in the center of the blackboard, and meticulously wrote these few words: “2014.4.22, Dali is healthy.”
Just this short sentence replaced information that was worth at least two billion yuan.

After writing these words, Hong Weiguo—whose spine had never bent before—walked to the window and slowly squatted down. Eyes squinted, he hummed a tune and smoked, causing a cloud of smoke to surround him.
Lan Ruoxi looked on with tears in her eyes.

She had only twice seen Hong Weiguo’s action of carefreely squatting down, humming, and smoking in all these years that they had walked together. The first time had been 26 years ago, when they had gotten engaged, and the second had been 19 years ago, when he had heard that she was pregnant.

Very quickly, he finished smoking the cigarette. Hong Weiguo looked at Lan Ruoxi, smiled, and said, “Today is the happiest day in these few years. Since Dali likes to play so much, and his body is much better now, why don’t I deposit another 50 million yuan into his card to let him play as he pleases?”

Lan Ruoxi rolled her eyes at him and said, “You’re so happy that you have lost your senses? Although we’re not unwilling to give him this money, there is no need to give him so much all at once. Fifty million yuan is not a small amount, it would be bad for him if someone targeted him for this money. Let’s just give him five million yuan first. That should be enough for him to spend for a few days. We can give him more after he finishes spending it.”
“OK, I shall listen to you.” Hong Weiguo laughed loudly and said, “As long as his body condition can change for the better, even if I have to waste five billion yuan, it is worth it!”
Naturally, Hong Dali was oblivious to the uproar back home. Currently, he was happily squandering.

The normally empty car park of the Ye Lai Xiang nightclub was practically a miniature car exhibition today. Various kinds of top-notch sports cars were lined up in as many as three rows. They were of various colors, from limousines to SUVs to top-notch sports cars—everything that one could imagine could be found here. This sight could totally blind the eyes of passersby.

Those with interest in cars could easily tell the value of these cars. It was not an exaggeration to say that the value of these cars added up was worth at least as much as two Ye Lai Xiang nightclubs, which was about 16 million yuan. Changing that to the RMB from Hong Dali’s previous life, that was a total value of about 80 million yuan.
How much was 80 million actually worth? One could buy 20 Lamborghinis that were worth 4 million yuan each, or 40 Land Rovers, which meant one for every classmate in Hong Dali’s class.
One could observe the degree of lavishness through this.
Inside Ye Lai Xiang.

“Big Bro Dali, this nightclub that you bought isn’t too bad. Hehe, the decorations and facilities and so are all quite complete.” Being Hong Dali’s trusted sidekick, Ling Yi naturally wouldn’t hold back his compliments for Hong Dali.

“From what Small Master1sees, this place is vigorous with purple color and dazzling with golden lights. This is entirely Dali’s tempo!” Du Xinzhen pretentiously said, shaking and swaying his head as he said so.

Zhu Xiaoling, whose hair was tied into a ponytail, enviously said, “Young Master Dali is indeed capable. It cost massive efforts for me to ask for a few hundred thousand from my family, while Young Master Dali easily forked out eight million yuan or so to buy this nightclub. You’re really awesome!”

Lang Hao had always disliked Hong Dali’s squandering ways. He stood at one side and scorned in a small voice, “Such squandering ways, I will definitely not learn from him. There isn’t much of a crowd here, and the location is average. I don’t have high regards for this place.”
Standing beside him, Wen Dongling violently pinched him and said, “Young Master Dali normally doesn’t care to be bothered with you. Can you just keep your mouth to yourself?”

Lang Hao shrugged and said, “OK, just take it that I’m jealous of him... But seriously speaking, the wine here is not bad.” He waved his hand at the attendant standing at the side. “What is the best wine that you have here? Give me two bottles!”
Wen Donglin stamped her feet violently. “I can’t be bothered with you anymore. You’re an embarrassment!”

It was worth saying that due to this class gathering, Hong Dali got to know some of his classmates. It was impractical to ask him to remember the names of everyone in one night, but just remembering the names of a few that were close to him was not a problem. For example, Ling Yi, who was always willing to follow him around; Du Xinzhen, who always addressed himself as small master; Zhu Xiaoling, who looked up to Hong Dali as an idol; Lang Hao, who always disliked how Hong Dali squandered; Lang Hao’s girlfriend, Wen Dongling, and so on.
Cliques were present anywhere, and Hong Dali was quite sure that these people were the ones in his clique.
Just as he thought of this, Ling Xiaoyi secretly came over and whispered into his ears: “Young Master, there are two people who want to see you; a guy and a lady. Do you want to see them?

chapters.title: Chapter 34 - The Noble Community Is Really Messy
paragraphs: “Hm? Does someone want to see me? What situation is this?” Hong Dali’s legs were resting on the tea table, and his female lackeys were massaging them while his hands were teasing the Samoyed Xiao Xiao. He curiously asked, “Do you know what is it that they want with me? If it isn’t related to squandering, then I’m not seeing them.”Looks like the process of squandering has to speed up. I only walked for about two kilometers and my legs are already so numb as if ants are biting into them.

Speaking of this, Hong Dali’s current health attribute was 46. In medical terms, he was only semi-healthy. If he were lucky, nothing would happen to him. If he were unlucky, he could fall sick and be tortured by an illness at any moment.
Therefore, to Hong Dali, the most important thing to do now was still to squander. There was no argument about that.

“The guy wants to transfer a website under his name. He heard that you are here and especially rushed over. As for the lady, her words were a bit ambiguous, so I’m not sure what her intentions are, but it seems to be something related to the entertainment industry.” Ling Xiaoyi reported factually.

Someone wants to sell his website? This is absolutely a heaven-sent chance to squander! Hong Dali abruptly sat up and asked, “How much is he planning to sell the website for? Is it real or fake? Are you sure he is not a crook?”

“I have already ascertained this. It is real. He’s planning to sell the website for three million yuan. But I said that I have to ask for your opinion first; thus, he is still waiting for my news now.” Ling Xiaoyi carefully asked, “Young Master, I have some knowledge regarding that website. The business is currently on a downhill slide and is close to bankruptcy. It is not particularly worth buying it...”

“If it was making a profit, why would he want to sell it? Tell him I’m willing to offer him 2.4 million yuan, paid in installments over six months. If he accepts, then buy the website. If he declines, ask him to leave.” Hong Dali decided without another word. “If he accepts, call my house and ask for some money; just say that I have run out of money. That is very important, don’t forget that.”

Regarding Hong Dali’s intentions, Ling Xiaoyi could never guess what he was thinking.For the sake of squandering, this Young Master doesn’t even bother to ask what the website is about before deciding to buy it. The wisdom of a godly man is really not fathomable by mortals like us.

Although this was what she was thinking in her mind, Ling Xiaoyi said, “Young Master, Master has already topped up five million yuan into your card. He says that you can spend it as you please. If it is not enough, you can just ask for more from him.”
“Oh? Really?” Hong Dali touched his chin. “In that case, there is no need to pay in installments. If he accepts 2.4 million yuan, just buy the website. You can go and tell him now.”
“Yes, Young Master.” Ling Xiaoyi bowed slightly, turned, and left.
Soon after, the robotic voice of the system sounded in Hong Dali’s mind:

“Current squandering value: 2,575,411 yuan. Second mission completed. Twenty-five attribute points are exchangeable. An additional 5 attribute points have been gained for completing the mission. Does the host wish to use the attribute points?”
Is there a need to ask this question? Hong Dali laughed until his saliva almost drooped out of his mouth. “Add all the points to my health attribute!”

This time, an entire 30 attribute points were added to his health attribute. Hong Dali felt a golden light flashing in his mind. All of the blood cells, muscle, and bonds in his body were squirming. The ecstasy he felt was indescribable.
This feels great! Brouhaha! The issue of the health problem that has been on my mind these days is finally solved!
Now, my health attribute is at 76 points! What kind of concept is that? This means I’m sub-healthy now.
That means that, although I might still fall sick and have a minor illness, unless I purposely seek death, there will definitely not be any more health problems!
However other things are, it is not comparable to my own life! Brouhaha!
His body was reformed very quickly. His body didn’t ache anymore, nor were his legs numb. Even when he breathed, he felt much more at ease now!

“The third mission is now announced: Rookie Prodigal. Mission requirement: Squander 15 million yuan within a month. Mission reward: 15 attribute points. After accomplishing this mission, the system will begin preparations for an upgrade. Once the host has raised every attribute to 100 points, the system will undergo an upgrade.”
Rook... rookie prodigal!? Squander 15 million yuan within a month, and that’s only a rookie prodigal?

Instantly, Hong Dali felt that the scale of his journey was toward the stars. It was unknown how the system would require him to squander next time, but that was still far off. The priority goal now was to focus on squandering and raising his attribute points.

Right then, Ling Xiaoyi, who was wearing a black maid outfit, came back. She stood behind him and softly said, “Young Master, the contract for the website has been signed. Then, as for the lady, do you want to go and see her? We have already searched her; there is no danger.”
“Oh right, there is still that lady. I forgot about her.” Hong Dali stood up and said, “Then let’s go see what she wants.”

The two of them walked inward and reached the entrance to a private room shortly after. There were already two male lackeys standing guard outside. Upon seeing Hong Dali, they immediately nodded and greeted him. “Greetings, Young Master. Everything is normal.”
Hong Dali’s personal safety was absolutely their top priority, they couldn’t afford to be careless in the slightest.
“En, I will go in and see what she wants.”

Pushing open the door and entering, Hong Dali scanned the room. The target was a woman of about 27-28 years old with looks slightly above average. Her expression showed anxiousness, and she kept tapping the tabletop with her finger. Upon seeing Hong Dali enter the room, she immediately stood up and asked, “Are you Young Master Dali?”

“Ah, yes, I am. You had something to see me about?” Hong Dali casually sat down on the sofa. In his heart, he was wondering, This woman doesn’t seem to be**1toward me, and judging from her expression, she doesn’t seem to be here to sell me something. What is she here for, then?
Luckily, the woman didn’t keep him in suspense. She directly said, “Young Master Dali, please rescue my young lady!”
“Rescue your young lady?” Hong Dali almost spat out his saliva. “If you want to rescue someone, you should call the police. I’m not Superman, who flies everywhere. What are you coming to me for?”
With his frail and sickly body, it was already a blessing that he didn’t require someone to rescue him. What was more, if people came to him to rescue others, then what was the police for?
The woman profusely apologized. “My apologies, my apologies. I’m sorry for not saying things properly. I was too anxious, I’m sorry.”

“That’s enough. You don’t have to be so courteous. Xiaoyi, get someone to get this sister a beverage. Why isn’t there even tea or water for her? That’s not how we should treat our guests.” Although he was the infamous prodigal, he still had his manners—he didn’t care about the small fee for the beverages anyway.
The woman profusely waved her hand. “No need, no need. Young Master, you’re too polite. I’m not worthy of your courtesy.”

Hong Dali shrugged and said, “It isn’t a big deal. Tell me what issue you have with me first. You want me to rescue your young lady? Was she kidnapped? Or is she lost? Or was she abducted and sold away?”
“That’s not the case.” The woman gave a slight sigh. “I’m the manager of my young lady. Speaking of which, this matter is related to the hidden rules of the community.”
“Oh, hidden rules.” Hong Dali stretched a finger in boredom and picked his nose. In the end, he said, “The noble community is really messy.”

chapters.title: Chapter 35 - Playing in the Film Industry Seems Quite Interesting
paragraphs: The noble community was really messy!

Hearing Hong Dali say this, the female manager was obviously choked for a while. But Hong Dali was her last hope; she couldn’t show her dissatisfaction. She hurriedly explained, “Young Master Dali, you’re mistaken. It is precisely because my young lady didn’t want to abide by the hidden rules that I’m here for your help. If she had been willing to abide by the hidden rules, then there wouldn’t have been a need for me to look for you, right?”
A small celebrity that hadn’t abided by the hidden rules? There was still such a rare species nowadays?
Hong Dali interest was slightly piqued. He nodded and said, “Yes, that’s quite rare. All right, tell me what’s going on first.”

“OK, OK!” Hearing that Hong Dali’s tone seemed to have loosened up a little, the female manager was relieved. She started to explain the situation. “My young lady is called Li Nianwei. She has had a good voice since she was young. She sings very well and is also very pretty. Therefore, she has always been very popular amongst her schoolmates. She always intended to enter the entertainment industry, and she studied at Tianjing Film Media University. Some time back, my young lady was selected by a star scout1from Huawei Entertainment and signed a contract with them. I then became her manager.”

“OK, so what happened after that? The director of your company set his eyes on her and wanted to play the hidden rules with her?” It was the entertainment industry, after all. Those kinds of issues were very common.

“Sigh, you’re right.” The female manager let out another sigh. “Actually, this kind of thing is very normal in our industry. Everyone understands it, but my young lady would rather die than abide. I didn’t intend to stick my hands into this matter at first, but my young lady is a very kind person, and we have gotten along very well during our time working together. If she isn’t willing, naturally, I will not advise her to do so.

“But no one expected that our director, he... he actually threatened to freeze her activities if she didn’t abide. Not only this, but he also messed with her family. Her father was only a department manager in a small company, and he has now been sacked because of our director. If I don’t help her think of something soon, I’m really afraid that she will not be able to bear the pressure and will succumb...

“Therefore, today, when I heard that Young Master Dali had bought this place and would be having a party here tonight, I guessed that I might be able to see you here. That’s why I came here uninvited to seek your help. Young Master Dali, please help her. I beg of you.”
When the female manager finished her speech, her eyes were red.
At this point, Hong Dali finally managed to grasp the situation.

The cause of the situation was really simple. This lady called Li Nianwei was said to be pretty and kind, and her company’s director had set his eyes on her—most likely to ask her to become his mistress or something—but this Li Nianwei had refused. As a result, her father’s job had been ruined by the director. This female manager couldn’t bear watching this go on and had, therefore, come seeking his help.
Not a big deal, but this seemed quite interesting. This was a golden opportunity to squander—how could he miss it!
Hong Dali nodded and said, “Yes, this matter seems quite interesting. Where is this Huawei Entertainment located?”
The manager immediately replied, “It is located on the 12th floor of the Tianfu Building at the center of the West Fourth Loop.”

Hong Dali waved over Ling Xiaoyi, who was standing to one side. “Xiaoyi, have you heard of this Huawei Entertainment before? And where is this Tianfu Building?” This manager had come to seek him at the last minute, showing that he hadn’t had a relationship or any interactions with her company before this. Thus, he didn’t need to be afraid of arousing suspicion about his identity even if he asked for information from others.

“I have heard of them before. Huawei Entertainment is a famous film company. They have groomed quite a few famous celebrities these few years. Their results in movies and music are not bad.” Ling Xiaoyi was indisputably a genius. She easily spouted all this information. “Tianfu Building is about three kilometers away from here. It is a 15-story office building. Huawei Entertainment has rented the 12th floor of the building.”
“I see.” Hong Dali touched his chin. “Speaking of which, playing around in the film industry seems quite interesting too... Can we buy this Huawei Entertainment? How much would that cost?”
Upon hearing Hong Dali’s words, the female manager felt cold air flow through her body and quivered.
This Young Master Dali is really terrifying. He wants to buy an entire entertainment company just because of this?

But this time, Ling Xiaoyi shook her head. “This is probably not easy to buy. Huawei Entertainment’s business is currently on an uphill trend. Even though you want to buy it, they might not be willing to sell it. Furthermore, it would definitely not be cheap.”

“Oh.” If Ling Xiaoyi said that it wouldn’t be cheap, then it definitely wouldn’t be. It was probably not something that he could buy with just eight or ten million yuan. It would likely require several hundred million yuan or more. It wasn’t worth playing on such a large scale just for some stranger, so Hong Dali changed his target. “Then, can we buy this Tianfu Building?”

This time, Ling Xiaoyi shook her head again. “Although this Tianfu Building can be considered real estate, its location is at the center of West Fourth Loop. The price will be quite high, and there isn’t much value in investing in it.” The underlying words were—Although this is also buying real estate, the price will be too high. Your family might not agree with it.

Although Hong Dali squandered, he didn’t do so blindly. If he wanted to buy this Tianfu Building, it would likely cost tens or hundreds of million yuan. Another point to consider was that since Huawei Entertainment had already rented space in it, most of the space in Tianfu Building was likely already rented out too. Even if there were money to be made by selling the building, the owner of the building didn’t necessarily have to sell it.
“In that case, Xiaoyi, do you have any good suggestions?” Hong Dali asked.

Since she was Hong Dali’s lead lackey now, Ling Xiaoyi could be considered to be half an adviser to him. After some thought, she suddenly smiled and said, “Young Master, weren’t you planning to buy that small hill? When we were walking the dogs just now, I coincidently found out that 200 meters to the south of the hill is an office building known as the Chenhui Building. It has 16 floors, and there weren’t many cars on the ground floor. There weren’t any logos of different companies on the different floors either. Business there seems to be doing quite poorly; the building’s owner might intend to sell it.”

Oh? There is such a good thing? Since my mission requires me to squander 15 million yuan within a month, setting up an entertainment company is just nice. That will definitely cause my money to flow out like water, and I can even satisfy my craving for being a film director!

Hong Dali was overjoyed and said, “Xiaoyi, you’re really something. Haha, you can even notice such a thing. Then it’s decided. I plan to open a film company and shoot some low-cost films to squander. Help me contact the owner to see if we can directly purchase the entire Chenhui Building.”
“Yes, Young Master.” Acknowledged Ling Xiaoyi. Then, she went to call his house.
“Then, Young Master Dali, my young lady...?” the female manager anxiously asked.

“Your young lady?” Hong Dali picked his nose. “I plan to open a film company to play around and squander, to satisfy my craving—I forgot about your case. Let’s do this: ask your young lady to come here now. The occasion here is not bad. Ask her to sing a song or two for me to listen to first.”

chapters.title: Chapter 36 - An Unforgettable Night
paragraphs: “This...” Hearing Hong Dali asking her Missy to sing at a nightclub like this, the manager appeared to be awkward. “Young Master Dali, there are too many people here. I’m afraid Missy will get a shock...”

“It’s good that there are many people here. There are even more people in a concert.” Hong Dali grinned as he said. “The masses have sharp eyes. A singer that can gain the liking of the masses must be a good singer. Otherwise, it’s useless regardless of how much you praise her. What do you think?”

Hong Dali was her last hope. Without his support, her bosom friend, Miss Li Nianwei, would only have two choices. One was to give in to the boss’ rule. The other was to be benched, which would mean not releasing a single record or song throughout the entire contract period and being forgotten by everyone once she was past the prime of her career.

Compared to these two choices, Hong Dali was not asking for much. And he was not wrong—if she didn’t have the guts to sing in front of the crowd here, it would be useless for her to be confident on her own.

In that case, we might as well go all out! No matter what, this Young Master was known for squandering. There were no rumors of him being a playboy, nor was there any gossip concerning women. She could rest assured that they would be safe. The manager took out her cell phone. “I’ll call our Missy now!”
As she made the phone call in a corner, Hong Dali asked Ling Xiaoyi, “Xiaoyi, that Huawei Entertainment, the boss looks rather domineering. Their company is making a lot?”

“They’re okay.” Ling Xiaoyi whispered. “Movies have not been doing well. The environment has not been very good, after all. But his company did produce two money-making movies. I heard there were about 60 million ticket sales, which earned them quite a bit. They’re at their peak. It should not be easy to take over their company at this time.”
Only 60 million ticket sales for two movies? So little?

Hong Dali got suspicious. In fact, it was only slightly more than 300 million yuan if converted to RMB. After deducting the cost of production and the movie theater’s share, there wasn’t much left. To have earned this little for two movies, it could only be considered a small production on Earth. It was just a little better than the worst. To think that this was considered “at their peak”?!
It seems like, in this world, making a movie is closely related to squandering. I like it!
Very soon, the manager walked over, appearing cheerful. “Young Master Dali, Missy will be here very soon.”

“Um, okay.” Hong Dali propped his feet up on the side table. Someone had already brought drinks over. He took one of them and started drinking. “Does she have any new songs? Old songs will do as well. But they must be good. Don’t sing songs that can put people to sleep. This is a nightclub, after all. You can’t make people sleep after singing two songs.”

“Yes, yes, yes.” The manager claimed delightedly. “The company hasn’t been writing songs for Missy due to the rules, but she has composed a few songs on her own, and they are not bad. I will get her to pick two songs with a livelier rhythm.”

“Ai yo, not bad. She writes her own songs? That’s great.” Hong Dali laughed. “If her songs please me, I’ll take her under my new company. I will even cover the fees for the breach of contract with Huawei. How does that sound?”
“Good, good!” The manager was elated to hear this.

Who was this person? The most famed prodigal in all of Tianjing City. To put it in simple terms, he had nothing but money. And there was one good thing about this young master: not only was he rich, but he also squandered money like nobody’s business.

To be under him, all the roads would open with his money. Even if the team was comprised of amateurs, it shouldn’t be too bad. When Missy got famous, she could help the company recruit a few experts. That was definitely better than working at Huawei in a state of anxiety. With the Hong family as their backers, who would dare to force Missy to do anything she didn’t like?
The classmates peered in and beamed as they saw Hong Dali. “I knew Bro Dali would be here. Bro Dali, what is the mystery present? Show it to us? Everyone can’t wait to see it!”

“Ah, that is all ready. Xiaoyi.” Hong Dali instructed his most trusted lackey. “Ask the men to bring in the little cuties. They can bring home whichever they like. Find someone to take care of the remaining ones. Um, not for free, of course. I’ll pay them 1,000 yuan a month, accommodation included.”

Taking care of dogs for 1,000 a month? That was equivalent to accommodation and a monthly salary of 5,000 on Earth. That would be a dream job in the capital. It was substantial enough in this world. Ling Xiaoyi quickly made arrangements.
It was an unforgettable night for those who came to the nightclub to have fun.

It was already bustling in the hall. Before long, some men pushed in cages of all sizes filled with hundreds of dogs. There were puppies, big and magnificent dogs, and small and furry dogs. In a moment’s time, the entire nightclub was filled with barking dogs and screams from people who were afraid of dogs. It was a huge mess.

The dogs brought in were purebreds specifically selected by Ling Xiaoyi. Each one of them cost at least a few hundred dollars. To allow the classmates to take their pick was a privilege other customers would not be able to enjoy.
If one liked dogs, they would really love these dogs. Even those that didn’t particularly like dogs wouldn’t hate these ones.

As expected, the girls from the class started screaming when they saw these little furballs. The entire hall echoed with their screams, one after another. Some of their pitches were as high as the whistle register, comparable to Vitas1on Earth.
A group of people was fighting to stand in front of the cage to request the puppies they had their eyes on.
“I want this one. This Chow Chow is so fun!”
“This Samoyed is too cute! Haha. I want this!”
“Er ha, come here. Er ha, let me touch you!”

The girls mainly went for the puppies. The puppies were the cutest. The boys went for the bigger dogs. Some even wanted Tibetan mastiffs. They could not move after they laid eyes on the Tibetan mastiffs. Hong Dali was giving the dogs away anyway. It would be a pity not to take them.

After about 10 minutes, all 41 classmates had a dog with them. Some held their dog by its leash, some carried their dog. Some classmates were laughing so hard seeing the puppies circling on the table.
Du Xinzhen happily petted the Tibetan mastiff puppy she was carrying in her arms. “I knew at the tip of my fingers that I was right to be here today. Haha. This Tibetan mastiff suits me just fine!”

“Brother Dali is awesome! I’ve been wanting to rear a dog for the longest time, but my family objected to it.” Ling Yimei happily claimed. “If I tell my parents that this Chow Chow was given by Brother Dali, they will definitely not oppose to it. Haha!”
Zhu Xiaoling fondly looked at the husky in her arms. “This husky is so much fun.” Smiling, she said, “This is not bad compared to the panda Sister Muxin has.”

Tang Muxin had had a considerable amount of fun tonight. When Hong Dali and Ling Xiaoyi had gone off to discuss some matters, as Hong Dali’s fiancée, she had only been able to help take care of Hong Dali’s classmates. “Xiao Xiaobai’s fur was dyed. I’m not sure what Dali was thinking, dyeing Xiao Xiaobai’s fur. It is so embarrassing to be seen by people.”

What she didn’t know was that after tonight, the price of white Chow Chows would shoot through the roof. Prices would start from 5,000 yuan. It would become trendy to buy a white Chow Chow and dye its fur to make it look like a panda!

chapters.title: Chapter 37 - “Lightning Pursuit,” Li Nianwei
paragraphs: While the classmates were having fun choosing their dogs, Hong Dali was occupied with something else.

Hearing how Hong Dali was paying 1,000 yuan a month as well as accommodations for someone to help take care of the dogs, the dog lovers fought to be chosen. The stage almost collapsed under everyone’s weight. The crowd all had their hands up, shouting:
“Choose me, choose me!”
“I can do that. I love dogs the best!”
“Choose me! I’ll only take 800!”
Everyone worked themselves into a frenzy. Nothing could be heard over the noise.
It was Xiaoyi who was smart enough to get a lackey to stand in a corner and hold a board stating: “Queue here to apply for the job. Those who cut the queue will not be accepted!”
“Queue here to apply for a job” didn’t have much impact. But seeing how those that cut the queue would not be accepted, everyone with that intention obediently queued and waited for their turn.

It was not the salary of 1,000 yuan that people were attracted to. It was the free accommodations that drew the crowd. This was in the capital, and renting a place to stay would cost at least 200 yuan. That was equivalent to 1,200 yuan a month. Besides, who could resist the perks of working for Young Master Hong Dali? If they did a good job, Hong Dali would definitely not hesitate to give them a pay raise.
In an instant, the nightclub turned into a job fair. Everyone was promoting themselves in order to earn a good job.

Hong Dali had not predicted the impact he would create by not charging customers every day for a week. Within a night, the volume of people visiting the area around the nightclub increased threefold. The nightclub was filled to the brim. All the peddlers and merchants filled up the street outside the nightclub, their business increasing at least fivefold. Even the bathhouses, restaurants, and hotels benefited from Hong Dali’s actions.
They were not of Hong Dali’s concern. At this moment, he was sitting in the reserved room with a young lady.

This lady was beautiful. Hong Dali cold understand why the boss of Huawei kept her hidden. This lady’s name was Li Nianwei, and she was almost on the same level as Tang Muxin. There were no words to describe someone who was so beautiful—so beautiful that no words seemed right. Tang Muxin was one of them. So was Li Nianwei.
Hong Dali could not find anything to say about her face. If he had to find a word to describe her...
Flawless.

And so, Li Nianwei was beautiful on the outside—her fair complexion was impeccable—and her eyes were big and bright. At a height of 1.68 meters, her body looked perfect, with the golden ratio. Her chest was full—neither too big nor too small. Just the right size.
Hong Dali particularly liked her voice. Her voice was sweet and alluring, calming and cozy to the ears.
A woman like this would drive men crazy.
This was Hong Dali’s impression of Li Nianwei.

Hong Dali continued to casually prop his leg on the side table, drinking the beverage he had in his hand. “It should be no problem for you to sing two songs later? Right? Just pretend you are at a concert venue.”
“Um. Okay.” It was the point of no return. Li Nianwei looked at Hong Dali before standing up. “Should I go now? Or later?”
“Now.” Hong Dali stood up with her. “Let’s go. Let me hear your voice. I will reward you if it is good. Hehe.”
“Young Master Dali, you flatter me.” Li Nianwei blushed as she followed Hong Dali and her manager out of the room.

On the stage, the DJ shouted into the microphone: “Ladies and gentlemen, we have a special guest tonight! This lady here is a singer! She’s so pretty that she can make one want to commit a crime! Her identity is a secret, and her voice will linger in your mind. What are we waiting for, then? Let’s welcome her with a round of applause!”
The audience was ecstatic.Clap, clap, clap, clap.This was the Hong family’s young master’s territory. Anyone who could stand on the stage at such a place had to be high caliber.
Sure enough, along with the elegant background music and the mesmerizing lights, Li Nianwei slowly walked up the stage and took over the microphone.
In an instant, a soft light shone over her face, highlighting the shape of her face and enhancing her beauty. One could not take their eyes away from her.
Zhu Xiaoling, who was sitting beside Tang Muxin, claimed in amazement. “Wah... Sister Muxin, this sister is so pretty. Where did Brother Dali find someone like this?”

Tang Muxin smiled and nodded her head while watching Li Nianwei on stage. “She is very pretty indeed. Is she a singer? Dali loves to do ridiculous things like that. I don’t know where he found her either. Perhaps this was the matter he was discussing?” Tang Muxin looked at Li Nianwei carefully and whispered. “She has tears in her eyes. Did she suffer from some injustice?”
Zhu Xiaoling looked carefully and nodded. “It seems like it. What happened? Did Brother Dali bully her?”

“No. Dali would not do something like that.” Hong Dali had not even made things difficult for the old man that had knocked his side mirror off. He wouldn’t bully a lady. Tang Muxin pondered the matter. “This sister is a singer? Perhaps it is her boss who made things difficult for her. That might be why she is here, to seek help from Dali?”
Zhu Xiaoling praised Tang Muxin. “Sister Muxin is good. That must be the case. Brother Dali would not bully anyone.”

The music slowly crept in, and Li Nianwei came to her senses. She exuded an unyielding aura on stage. In a split second, she seemed like the queen of the stage. “Hi, everyone. My name is Li Nianwei, and I’m a singer. I would like to sing a song that I wrote—’Lightning Pursuit.’ I hope everyone will like it.”
The music started, and Li Nianwei changed completely. She was like the wind, the lightning, like a flash of light radiating in all directions. The lights could not mask the aura she was exuding.
She was like the sun, so bright that one did not dare to look directly at her.
The excitement of the crowd in Ye Lai Xiang heightened. Everyone was clapping along with the rhythm and shouting Li Nianwei’s name.
It took only one song to turn the almost two thousand people in the hall into her fans.

Hong Dali expressed his satisfaction toward Li Nianwei. “Um. Interesting. Haha. Not bad, manager. I will take her under me from now on. Both of you can call me young master. If you encounter any difficulties, just look for Xiaoyi.”
The manager was overjoyed. Her voice choked as she said, “Thank you very much, Young Master!”

chapters.title: Chapter 38 - Lighting That Cost 20 Million Yuan
paragraphs: Very quickly, Li Nianwei finished the two songs, one energetic, “Lightning Pursuit,” which showed off her queenly side, and a sentimental one, “Fantasy Light-Year.” The entire audience went frantic.

The fans in this world were much simpler than those from Hong Dali’s previous life. As long as the singers were not too ugly and their singing was nice to the ear, that was enough for them. This was different from his previous life, where the singers had to be packaged, promoted, and sometimes even paired with a background story that could bring tears to people’s eyes.
Li Nianwei returned the microphone, walked down the stage amidst the fanatical cheering of the audience, and stood in front of Hong Dali. “Young Master Dali, is... is my singing ok?”
She was quite confident in her own strength, but she wasn’t sure if she could gain the acknowledgment of Hong Dali. Therefore, she was quite nervous.

“Silly girl, Young Master has agreed. From now on, you are an artist under the Young Master’s company.” Her manager tugged her elbow and hurriedly said, “Quick, greet him as ‘Young Master’! Because of you, Young Master purposely set up a filming company and bought an office building, the Chenhui Building in the fourth loop!”

Hearing that Hong Dali had agreed, tears of joy flowed out from Li Nianwei’s eyes, and her voice shook. “Young... Young Master.” Actually, her dream was very simple. She only wished to focus on writing and singing songs. She liked to sing, and if there were people that liked to hear her sing, then that was enough for her.

Hong Dali smiled cheerfully, twitched his nose, and said, “You sang quite well. You shall work under me from now on. You are now the first artist in my company and its base member.” Having said this, Hong Dali touched his chin. “En, speaking of which, my company doesn’t have a name yet. That’s not suitable.” As he spoke, Hong Dali suddenly looked at the female manager. “Oh ya, I don’t know your name yet.”
The female manager excitedly said, “My name is Zhang Cai. Cai1for colorful.”

“OK, got it.” Hong Dali’s expression was very calm as if giving a name to his new company wasn’t important to him at all. He casually said, “In that case, let’s just name this company Caiwei Entertainment. It’s simple and easy to remember.”
Li Nianwei and Zhang Cai were entirely stunned. “Cai... Caiwei?”

Such a big issue, buying an office building and setting up an entertainment company, yet in the end, their names were used to name the company? This young master, could it be that these things were really of no importance to him?

Being a superprodigal, for Hong Dali, this matter was actually just a good way for him to squander. The movie industry in this world was doing poorly. As a matter of fact, according to his knowledge, all the businesses that were related to entertainment were not doing very well.

The fee that an artist, even the current most popular artist in the country, was paid for attending an activity was at most about 200,000 yuan. Although their fans might like them a lot, they would definitely not be as fanatical as the fans from Hong Dali’s previous life.

Therefore, spending so much money on an artist was definitely not profitable. No matter how hard Li Nianwei worked, the best result that she could have was earning a few million yuan for the company. This money was practically nothing compared to the money spent to purchase an office building.

Hong Dali brought Li Nianwei and Zhang Cai to a corner of the nightclub and asked, “Your name is Li Nianwei, am I right? Well, Sister Nianwei, the songs that you have written so far, are they enough to open a concert?” By now, his classmates had already gathered around them. Each of them was carrying a dog with them, creating quite the comical scene.

Li Nianwei was shy with strangers. Adding the fact that she was quite excited right now, she didn’t dare to sit with Hong Dali, instead sitting on the edge of the sofa. Head lowered, she softly said, “Yes, I have written 17 or 18 songs so far. It should be enough.”
“That’s good to hear. We shall open an outdoor concert here at the plaza in West Fourth Loop tomorrow night!” Hong Dali laughed loudly. “This time, I am going to squander big time, hahaha!”

Tang Muxin carried her pet, Xiao Xiaobai, which was dyed to look like a panda, and sat beside Hong Dali. She asked curiously, “Dali, are you seriously going to open a concert? That will be very troublesome. You will have to go and rent the stereo sound system, stage lighting, and so on. Most importantly, there isn’t enough time to advertise.”

Hong Dali pointed at the 2,000-plus heads on the dance floor and said, “Advertising is easy. There are so many people here, just get them to help. These people will help us advertise. Add some posters and whatnot, easy.”

Ling Xiaoyi had always been standing beside Hong Dali. Her duty was to satisfy Hong Dali’s every request. She immediately softly asked, “Young Master, why don’t we delay the concert by another two days? Since the purpose is to help Lady Nianwei boost her popularity, it is best to do it with a bigger scene. The West Fourth Loop sports stadium is just three kilometers to the north from here and has a seating capacity of 40,000 people. If you include the football field, it can accommodate up to 50,000 people. Why don’t we rent that for a night? We’ll also have time to do some proper advertising.”

“Oh? The West Fourth Loop football stadium!?” Hong Dali’s eyes brightened up as if they were 200-watt light bulbs. “I agree! Hurry, help me calculate how much money I will be able to squander. I want an accurate amount!”
Beside him, Tang Muxin and his classmates let out a sigh.Young Master Dali is going to squander again...

Ling Xiaoyi carefully calculated and, shortly after, said, “For now, about two million yuan should be enough. Five hundred thousand yuan to rent the place—there don’t seem to be any competitions being held there this period, so it should be enough. The stereo sound system should cost about 100,000 to 300,000 yuan. The lighting and stage added up should cost about 500,000 yuan. The remaining money can be used to print fliers for advertising. Two million yuan should be enough.”

“Two million yuan, this is not a bad sum!” Hong Dali immediately decided, but then immediately added, “I want the best stereo sound system, the kind that costs 500,000 yuan a night. For the stage, I want it to to be on a scale that uses 500,000 yuan. As for the lighting, hehe...”
This laughter caused the hairs of the people around him to stand. Even the 40-plus dogs instantly began barking.
Tang Muxin said in a low voice, “Dali, why did you give such a sinister laugh? It scared me.”

“I have a good idea for the lighting, haha!” Hong Dali loudly laughed again before saying, “Since I am going to squander, I must squander on a scale that is grand and mind-blowing! How can normal lighting be enough? I have a great idea. It will definitely make everyone satisfied!”
As Hong Dali’s most loyal sidekick, Du Xinzhen said, “This small master has used my fortune-telling skills to calculate that Big Bro Dali definitely has a good idea!”
His classmates: “We can tell that even without your calculation!”
Indeed, they saw Hong Dali very forthrightly stand up and say, “For lighting, we shall use 20 million yuan!”

“What the heck!” His classmates were shocked to the point of collapsing on thefloor2. Tang Muxin was so shocked that her eyes opened wide into circles. “Dali, what kind of lighting is worth 20 million yuan! Are you talking in your dreams? You can buy a whole set of the best lighting in the country with just about 300,000 yuan!”

“That just shows how ignorant you are, OK?” Hong Dali chicly tossed his hair. “Use my Soaring Angel’s extended headlights as the main lighting, with one Prayer Angel on each side. All of you can also drive your cars over too. We shall use the cars’ headlights as lighting for Sister Nianwei! Hmph Hmph, I guarantee that you will not be able to find a second lighting set in the country that can squander as much as this!”

chapters.title: Chapter 39 - This Smoke Is Too Choking
paragraphs: When these words came out, his classmates were all astonished.

Indeed, in the 5,000-year history of the Heavenly State, it wasn’t possible to find another set of lighting that squandered so much. One Soaring Angel, two Prayer Angels, plus his classmate’s super sports cars. This luxurious lighting was unlikely to be surpassed for 300 years in the past or future!
Look at his limit-breaking method of squandering!
Tang Muxin face-palmed her forehead with a “phat” sound. “My god, when will this ever end...”

“Sister Nianwei, the rest will depend on your skills. Do your best!” Hong Dali laughed loudly and lay his head on his elbow. “I have made all of the arrangements for the concert. Don’t throw away my face when the time comes! Speaking of which, you haven’t held a concert before, right?”

Li Nianwei nodded. “Not... not yet!” She had to face such a big scene so suddenly. No one would be able to accept this easily. Li Nianwei found it very unrealistic. More importantly, she was filled with apprehension, as she feared that she would mess up the concert. “Young Master, am I... am I really capable of doing this?”
“Of course, you are.” Hong Dali said naturally. “If I say you can do it, then you can definitely do it.”
His classmates clapped. “These words are really domineering!”

Then, Hong Dali added, “If you can’t do it, how am I supposed to squander?” After finishing this sentence, Hong Dali suddenly remembered that a dancing band was required for a concert. He immediately instructed, “Xiaoyi, contact two groups of backup dancers later. Ask them to bring some people here to do some rehearsing.”

“Yes, Young Master.” Ling Xiaoyi softly said. “Young Master, it is getting quite late. We should go back now. If we don’t return now, Master and Madam will get anxious. And... and Lady Muxin, we also have to send her home too.” She had originally wanted to say “Young Madam,” but there were too many people here. From Tang Muxin’s attitude toward Hong Dali so far, she could see that Tang Muxin wasn’t very happy with people calling her Young “Madam.” Therefore, she had hurriedly changed her words.
Tang Muxin was very pleased with Ling Xiaoyi’s understanding of her. She smiled and said, “She’s right. It is almost 11 PM. We should head back home now.”

“Then let us go home!” Hong Dali stood up and stretched. Then, he said to his classmates, “You guys can find everything you need in this place. If you don’t want to go home, you can just stay here. As for those of you who are going home, that isn’t my concern. I shall be going off first, haha.”
“See you, Big Bro Dali!”
“Walk slowly, Big Bro Dali!”
After sending Tang Muxin back home, Hong Dali was still quite energetic.

He had squandered two million yuan today and gained a total of 30 attribute points after completing the mission. After adding them to his health attribute, he was no longer the frail and sickly person he had once been. Even his mental spirit had been boosted, so it was absolutely normal that he wasn’t sleepy due to the excitement.

On the way home, Hong Dali leaned against the window and looked out at the scenery. But in his heart, he was calculating.When all the items and types of equipment for the concert are in place, that will be another two million yuan squandered. By that time, my health attribute should be almost maxed out. Oh ya, once my health attribute is maxed out, then my sexual capability attribute can be raised. Isn’t that how the saying goes? A man can be incapable of anything but that!
Being a healthy man, that was definitely something that he couldn’t disregard.

Soon after, the vehicles entered the entrance to Hongwu Villa and passed by the two gigantic jade statues. The thought of seeing his parents shortly caused Hong Dali’s heart to be filled with anticipation. In his previous life, he had been an orphan. His longing for kinship was greater than anything else.
The four vehicles followed the path all the way uphill. Moments later, they arrived at the entrance to the villa.

The old butler was already standing in wait there. Upon seeing Hong Dali return, he immediately walked over, pulled open the car door, and cheerfully said, “Young Master Dali, you have come home. Please enter. Master and Madam were already getting anxious waiting for you.”

“I am home!” Hong Dali alighted from the car. Like a stray dog let loose, he rushed into the villa, shocking the old butler, who chased after him and shouted. “Oh my, Young Master Dali, please slow down. Don’t fall over yourself!”
Once Hong Dali entered the villa, he realized that the atmosphere didn’t seem quite right.

Two rows of attendants were lined up neatly in the first-floor living room. Upon seeing him, they bowed and said in unison, “Congratulations, Young Master Dali!” This array was as if they were welcoming the head of the state.
Hong Dali was almost frightened to the point of falling on his butt.Congratulating me? What for? It’s not like I am pregnant...

While he was having a shock, Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi were also as shocked as he was. Lan Ruoxi hurriedly rushed over and grabbed his elbows. She painstakingly said, “Oh my, you small rascal, are you crazy? Why are you running so fast? What would happen if you fell down!”

Hong Weiguo stood at one side and looked him up and down with a solemn expression. After which, he rested his hand on Hong Dali’s chest and felt Hong Dali’s heartbeat for a while. He then laughed loudly. “Hahaha, Dali’s body condition has finally improved! This is heaven’s blessing, heaven’s blessing! Even though he ran so fast just now, his heart rate didn’t increase much!”
“That’s good, that’s good!” Lan Ruoxi’s tears immediately flowed. “Dali’s body has finally recovered, haha. Look at me, this should be a joyous occasion...”
These two people, they are really too good to me.

Hong Dali had been an orphan from a young age. His deepest desire had always been to have a parents’ care and love. Unfortunately, this wish hadn’t been able to be satisfied in his previous life. Here, he finally experienced this feeling that would forever be etched in his heart.

Stretching out a hand and gently wiping away Lan Ruoxi’s tears, Hong Dali cheerfully said, “Mum, ain’t I very well now? What are you crying for?” Although this was what he said, the corner of his eyes was also wet. He forcefully controlled his tears, not letting them drop down.
Finally... I also have a home, a home that truly belongs to me!

“You small rascal, you have no idea how worried I was for you in the past. I was really afraid that one day when I woke up, I wouldn’t be able to see you anymore.” Lan Ruoxi gently said, helping Hong Dali straighten out his messy hair. “Finally, thanks to heaven’s blessing, your body has finally recovered. When I heard from Old Wang1today how you walked two kilometers and didn’t feel tired, I couldn’t believe it! Now, I finally believe it...”

Hong Weiguo squatted at one side and smoked. As he smoked, he hummed a small tune. After a few mouthfuls, he laughed. “Look at the two of you. This is a good thing, yet you two are tearing up, just like the melodramatic dramas broadcast at 8 PM.”
Hong Dali turned and hugged Hong Weiguo’s neck. “Dad, my body is much better now. It’s not as weak as before. I reckon that it will get even better after some more time.”
When he finished this sentence, Hong Weiguo violently rubbed his eyes. “Oh my, this smoke is really choking. It choked me until tears came out...”.

chapters.title: Chapter 40 - This Is Truly My Biological Mother
paragraphs: Hong Dali’s body condition had improved. This could be said to be the most important event that had happened in Hongwu Villa in the past 10 years. The entire villa was bustling with light. Lan Ruoxi personally cooked four dishes, and the family of three happily had dinner together. Hong Weiguo was so happy that he drank quite a bit of wine. Although they didn’t talk much during the meal, Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi’s eyes were smiling when they looked at Hong Dali.

“Dali, try this. This is your Mum’s specialty. She rarely cooks this, not even for me.” Hong Weiguo kept adding food to Hong Dali’s plate until it was stacked into a small mountain. “Eat some more. A man is iron while rice is steel1. If you don’t eat more, your body won’t improve quickly.”

As for Lan Ruoxi, she kept advising Hong Weiguo. “What are you doing? Look at this, his food is already stacked almost higher than he is. Who could possibly eat so much... Dali, eat slowly. If you like, I will cook for you every day. Careful, don’t choke yourself. Slow down, slow down!”

Hong Dali’s mouth was full of delicious food. While eating, he said, “You don’t have to help me take food, I can do it myself... I can’t eat anymore, I am going to bloat. I won’t be able to sleep if that happens!”

Their only son’s body condition had turned for the better. That was better than anything else. Although it was time for Hong Dali to go to bed, Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi couldn’t contain their excitement. After Hong Dali went to bed, they continued eating and chatting until about 3 AM before finally going to sleep.

Yesterday’s party had lasted the entire night. Therefore, Hong Weiguo and Lan Ruoxi gave special permission for the attendants to rest for one night so they could party to their heart’s content. Food and beverages were available in the villa. On this happy occasion, the attendants ate and drank to their hearts’ content. After all, if they restricted themselves during such a happy event, it would be pretentious of them.

However, when Hong Dali woke up to go to school the next day, other than the driver and his nine lackeys, all the attendants of the villa were littered on the floor, and the entire villa smelled of alcohol. Even then, when he went down the stairs, he heard his mother laughing and saying, “Look at all of you, all of you drank so much. Forget it, since there is no rush anyway, all of you can take a good rest. Our Dali’s body has recovered. I am very happy, so I shall give all of you another half day off. Additionally, everyone shall be tipped 10,000 yuan, to let my Dali enjoy the happy atmosphere!”
Hong Dali supported himself on the stairs and walked down. “Mum, I am going to school now.”

“Ai, I am here!!!” Hearing Hong Dali’s voice, Lan Ruoxi turned and happily said, “You small rascal, you have already prepared everything. Remember to wear more clothes. The wind is very strong today; don’t get catch a cold. Oh, right, is your allowance enough? This morning, I heard from Xiaoyi that you spent quite a bit yesterday. I will ask your Dad to top up your card with another five million yuan later.”

“Yes... it is not quite enough.” Hong Dali wiped his nose. “How much did I spend yesterday? I think it was about 2.4 million yuan. I bought a website and signed a female artist. Mum, I plan to set up an entertainment company to shoot some films and produce some music for fun. That will be quite interesting. If not, when there isn’t much to play with, I can watch movies!”

“OK, you can do whatever you want. Your dad and I have earned so much money, it would be a waste to not spend some of it.” Lan Ruoxi went up to him and carefully tidied his clothing for him. “If you want to watch movies, then we shall film them ourselves. You don’t have enough actors, do you? Do you want me to help you find some?”

Hong Dali thought for a while and said, “There is no rush for this. I will slowly tinker with it myself. Since his pocket money wouldn’t be lacking anyway, there was no rush.

“OK, you call the shots. Oh, right, I heard that the female artist from yesterday sang quite well. Weren’t you going to open a concert for her?” Lan Ruoxi grabbed Hong Dali and nagged. “I checked on her background this morning. She’s a good candidate. It’s rare that she hasn’t gotten a boyfriend all these years, though she is slightly old. Why not take her as your woman? I want to have a grandson soon...”
Hong Dali was astonished when he heard what she said. “Mum, I am only 18 this year. Aren’t you a bit too impatient? Anyway, I already have Xinxin, don’t I...”

“That lass, Xinxin, doesn’t fancy my little prodigal. Do you think I can’t see that? A forced relationship won’t end well. That day when they came and visited, I had already perceived that the engagement was fake. Only the borrowing of money is real.” Lan Ruoxi cheerfully said. “Actually, with the relationship between our families, lending one or two hundred million yuan to them is really nothing. The main issue is that your Uncle Tang doesn’t like to owe favors, so he came up with the engagement plan. I understand him. He treasures his face more than anything. Our families have been close with each other for so many years, I can understand.”

Speaking to this point, Lan Ruoxi held Hong Dali’s hands and said, “You shouldn’t take it too seriously. There are good ladies everywhere. If that lass Xinxin is willing to be married to you next time, then just marry her. If she isn’t, it’s fine to call off the engagement too. I plan to search for a few more wives for you to have more children anyway, heh heh.”

Hong Dali’s scalp went numb. This was truly his biological mother. If she carried on speaking, she would probably talk about her grandson’s wife. He immediately ran away, saying, “OK, I got it. I am going to school now...”
In the car, Hong Dali asked Ling Xiaoyi, “Oh right, Xiaoyi, the website that I bought yesterday, what is it about? I forgot to ask at that time.”

Ling Xiaoyi was speechless. He had spent 2.4 million to buy the website, yet he had no idea what it was about. This kind of situation could only possibly happen with him. Although this was what went on in her mind, her mouth replied, “Young Master, this website is called Ling Dian. It isn’t very popular. It is a website built for online novels.”

“A website for online novels? That isn’t too bad.” Hong Dali muttered. “Ling Dian doesn’t sound nice. Since we bought it, let’s change the name to Zhong Dian. Let it be the final destination2for readers. No one shall leave once they enter our website!”

“OK, Young Master.” Ling Xiaoyi forced herself not to laugh. “Then this Ling... Zhong Dian website, how should we handle it? Let it develop by itself, or invest some capital into it and do some advertisement or something?”

“Burn money. We need to burn much more money on it!” Hong Dali decided with a second thought. “I want to squander! Such a golden opportunity to squander that dropped from the sky, this is definitely a wonderful thing.”
After some thought, he asked, “Oh right, why did that guy want to sell this website? I wasn’t paying attention to him when he was speaking.”

Ling Xiaoyi answered, “That’s because of the beatdown his rival, Turkey Bookstore, gave them. Turkey Bookstore is currently the biggest online novel website in our nation. This Zhong Dian website loses out to them in all aspects. Therefore, the site traffic dropped dramatically, resulting in him selling the website.”

chapters.title: Chapter 41
paragraphs: “Turkey Bookstore? This is quite intractable. I knew that Turkey was very powerful. It’s the largest chatting software in the state now, right?” Hong Dali twitched his nose. This thing was similar to the QQ from his previous life. It wasn’t some ordinary company.

“Yes, that’s right.” Ling Xiaoyi aptly informed him. “I checked with Madam this morning. Young Master Liu Mingcheng, who quarreled with you yesterday, is the second son of the CEO of Turkey Enterprise, Liu Zhiwei. This Turkey Bookstore is under his name.”

En? This Liu Mingcheng is the second son of the CEO of Turkey Enterprise, Liu Zhiwei? This guy dared to go against me in school; this suggests that the Liu family and the Hong family’s relationship isn’t too good. Our families are most likely rivals in the business world—the unfriendly kind. If not, with his identity as only the second son, he wouldn’t have dared to go too far with me.
Since this Turkey Bookstore is his, this case is even more interesting. I shall play with him properly.

Since no matter how I squander, I’m still squandering, and my parents are so good to me, treasuring me like a baby, I might as well help them go against their rival while I am doing it. At least the money won’t be wasted. I don’t expect myself to be awesome, but I shall wish for my opponent to fail!

As he thought about this in his heart, though he couldn’t say it directly, as that wouldn’t be matching with his character, Hong Dali cheerfully said, “Since this is the case, let’s play a good one with him. En, when you are free, help me find out all the details and information about this Turkey Bookstore. That rascal Liu Mingcheng dared to go against me in school. I am not going to let him get away with it. This time, I shall squander on this matter, haha!”
“Yes, Young Master,” Ling Xiaoyi replied.

Seeing that they had reached the school, Hong Dali gave his last orders. “As for Caiwei Entertainment, you shall be responsible for hiring people. I shall not concern myself with it since I have no knowledge in this field anyway.”
Qian Ge Headquarters Building, Tianjing City Central, Level 16.

“CEO Hong.” The secretary stood in Hong Weiguo’s office, doing his report on the development of West Fourth Loop. “The progress on West Fourth Loop is going quite smoothly. We have already settled on three pieces of land, namely 60,000, 74,000, and 105,000 square meters. These three pieces of land are not too far from Ye Lai Xiang. The current buildings there are mainly old residential buildings, so the cost isn’t too great. They cost 40 million yuan, 66 million yuan, and 120 million yuan respectively. The last one costs a bit more because its location is comparatively more populated and crowded.”

These three pieces of land already cost more than 200 million yuan alone, but Hong Weiguo didn’t even blink an eye. Instead, he spoke of something irrelevant. “Yesterday, Dali made me happy for quite a while. His body condition has improved significantly. That’s a good thing.”

The secretary wasn’t sure what Hong Weiguo was trying to say. Luckily, Hong Weiguo went back to the topic right after. “Therefore, I have decided to give a 2,000 yuan red packet to everyone in the company, to build a happy atmosphere for Dali.”
If there were red packets to be given, that was, of course, a good thing.
The secretary hurriedly bowed and said, “Then I shall give my thanks to you first, CEO Hong.”

“En.” Hong Weiguo inhaled a mouth of smoke, smiled, and said, “I think that, although Dali likes to squander, it has helped his body change for the better. That is good news. Pass down the message: increase the investment capital to 400 million yuan and purchase some more land around Ye Lai Xiang. If there is no more land, purchase those residential estates that are on sale to let Dali raise dogs for fun.”
Hearing this, the secretary immediately continued his report. “CEO Hong, our men are already doing it. Just that... just that...”
“Just what? There is some problem?” Hong Weiguo asked in a baffled tone.

“Yes.” The secretary handed a document to Hong Weiguo. “Currently, the only pieces of land available for purchase are these three pieces. The rest have already been developed. Furthermore, yesterday night, we started to purchase those normal residential estates for sale. But... not a lot. We only purchased about 30-some of them, and we spent a total of 22 million yuan or so.”
“Oh? So little?” Hong Weiguo kept silent for a while. “Then what about the Chenhui Building and the hill with Fengyuan Lake? How were the negotiations?”

The secretary reported, “The negotiations for these two places went very smoothly. The asking price for Chenhui Building was 32 million yuan. We reckon that we will be able to get it at a lower price. As for Fengyuan Lake, the Bureau of National Resources didn’t ask for a very high price, only 55 million yuan. But the procedures are a bit complicated, so we still need some time.”

“En, looks like the current difficult part is the residential area around Ye Lai Xiang.” Hong Weiguo tapped the table lightly. “Try your best to buy that piece of land too. Then, we will be able to own all the land around Ye Lai Xiang. As for the residential estates, ask the business service department to think of something. My aim is to own all the land around Ye Lai Xiang so that it will be easier to plan and develop next time.”
“Yes, CEO Hong.” After receiving the latest orders, the secretary turned and exited the room, lightly closing the door as he did so.

After the secretary left, Hong Weiguo looked thoroughly at the map. “The location of Ye Lai Xiang is more toward the west, and it can be considered to be at the outer ring of the fourth loop. If not because Dali set his eyes on the hill near Fengyuan Lake, I wouldn’t have carefully observed this area.

“If the land around here can be chained together, although it is only a very small part of the fourth loop, if it is developed properly, the prospects look quite good. We can build a pedestrian street and, open up some roads that connect to the parks. Then there will be hotels, restaurants, and entertainment all in one.

“Looks like the hardest part now is instead the cheapest residential estates. If these commoners don’t cooperate, that will be a very difficult task. After all, we can’t force them to move away. En, let’s just wait for the news for now. There is no point trying to rush anyway. If 400 million yuan isn’t enough, use 500 million yuan. If 500 million yuan isn’t enough, use 600 million yuan. As long as Dali likes it, I shall let him play on a large scale. This child’s eyesight is not too bad anyway, heh heh.

“Oh right, after purchasing all this land, I shall build a few villas on the hill at Fengyuan Lake. Then we can go there to rest and relax, and we can row boats too. That will definitely feel very good.”
At the same time, in the residential area around Ye Lai Xiang.

“Old Man, have you heard? There is a young master from a wealthy family purchasing the estates in this area, supposedly for the purpose of raising dogs. A few families that I knew were selling their estates have successfully sold away their estates, and at a good price too,” an old woman said to her mate as she was knitting a sweater.
The old man lay on a bamboo chair, shaking a fan and drinking tea. “So what if they sell? What has that got to do with us?”

“I was thinking. Since our grandson is already so big, why don’t we sell our house too? Then we can buy two small ones. It is a waste for just the two of us to live in such a big house anyway. What do you think?” The old woman put down the sweater and said, “Look around us. This 90-square-meter house is too empty with just the two of us.”

“Aiya, what are you doing meddling with the youngster’s stuff? No, I am not selling the house. After we sell, we will still have to move to another place. That’s too troublesome.” The old man mumbled and turned his body to the other side.
“That’s true. Then let’s not sell it. We shall see how things go next time, then decide.”

chapters.title: Chapter 42 - An Unexpected Reward
paragraphs: “Hey, have you heard? Someone seems to have been buying the houses here recently. It is said that a young master from a wealthy family is buying houses to raise dogs. I went to ask around this morning; the houses around here have almost all been sold. There aren’t even any houses available for rent now.”
“The world of the rich is not something that we can understand. Buying so many houses just to raise dogs, heh heh, he has so much money that he is just burning it.”

“Isn’t that the case? Several million used just to raise dogs, sigh. Oh, right, I heard that those taking care of the dogs for him even get salaries of 1,000 yuan a month as well as a place to stay. This guy is a real prodigal. I have never seen anything like this before.”
In the residential area near Ye Lai Xiang.
The sound of dogs barking could constantly be heard.
Woof woof woof!!
Woof woof woof!!
Ahwooo!!

“Damn it! How is one supposed to live like this! Whose dog is looking for death so early in the morning! And it’s not just one but a bunch!” A guy furiously covered his head with his blanket, but after a while, he tossed it away. “AHHHHH, I can’t take it anymore. I am going to whack someone! What the heck is this! It’s just like a bunch of flies humming in my ears. I am going to kill someone! Oh, no, I am going to kill dogs!”

His wife grabbed him and said, “You don’t want to live anymore? The one raising the dogs is a young master from a super-rich family! It is said that he bought dozens of houses just to raise dogs alone. How are you going to be able to win against him? Let’s just wait. After some time the situation will improve.”

“What... what the heck, this is a nuisance! A nuisance! I am going to sue him!” the guy grumbled, obviously knowing the chances of winning the lawsuit were very low. Finally, he angrily covered his head with the blanket again. “Even if we can’t fight against him, can’t we hide from him? If he makes me angry, I will just sell the house to him. We can just move away!”
Disregarding what was happening there, moving back to Hong Dali, he was now carefreely sleeping in class again.
For someone who had graduated from university with honors in his past life, the lessons in high school were too simple for him. Whether or not he listened to the lesson was of no meaning to him.
His face was facing the left side as he slept for one lesson. When he got tired of the position, he changed sides and faced the right side to sleep for another lesson...

When he woke up, he took out his phone. There was a message that Ling Xiaoyi had sent him. [Young Master, the entertainment company has started hiring. A team has agreed to join us. Master is already arranging to transfer ownership of the Chenhui Building. It should be done very soon.]
Speaking of which, having such a competent assistant really saved him quite a lot of hassle.

Hong Dali replied with a message: [How are things going with Sister Nianwei? Has she started rehearsing? What about the sports stadium? They can start building the stage now. I want the best one available. En, and increase the scale of the advertisements. For now, just advertise around the area in West Fourth Loop. Make the slogan “Free concert, all welcome.” I only have one condition: the number of attendees must be high during the concert! I do not just want a few thousand people scattered around.]

Being a seasoned music producer, Sheng Wenshi and his two other colleagues were in charge of auditing and recommending new songs. In Heavenly State’ most popular music broadcasting software company Ku Ge, there existed six groups of people like them. Sheng Wenshi’s job was to further classify the qualified songs into different ranks and put them on the Ku Ge software to be recommended to the public according to their rank.

This job seemed to be very enjoyable, but in practice, it was totally the opposite. Even though most songs had already been audited before he listened to them, they still sounded weird to the ears. It wasn’t an exaggeration to say that the ears were filled with demonic sounds.
Especially when he had to do it day after day, year after year. Sheng Wenshi felt that it was thanks to heaven’s blessing that he hadn’t already suffered a mental breakdown.

Early in the morning, when Sheng Wenshi was listlessly listening to unintelligible songs, his colleague suddenly rushed in enthusiastically. He had a love-struck expression, and his saliva was almost dropping out. “Old Sheng, I found a treasure yesterday, a treasure!”
“You won five million yuan gambling?” Sheng Wenshi waved his hand in front of his colleague. “What made you so excited?”
“Do you remember the mission we accepted? The one regarding the theme song for the movieWind Pursuer?” His colleague wiped his saliva and stared at Sheng Wenshi with eyes like lightbulbs.

“Don’t look at me like that, as if you are a goldfish.” Sheng Wenshi stepped back twice from shock. “I know about the mission. The higher-ups asked us to help select the theme song, but the problem is that so far, there haven’t been any suitable songs. Why, have you found a prospect? Let me hear it.”Wind Pursuerwas one of the rare majorly produced films in Heavenly State these few years. Production of this movie was said to have cost eight million yuan or so. It was of the science fiction genre and was the most anticipated film of the year. It wasn’t just one of the most anticipated films—it wasthemost anticipated film. Because of this, the mission to find a suitable theme song for this movie was exceptionally difficult.

“I not only found the song but even secretly recorded it!” His colleague started to drool upon mentioning this. “You have no idea how pretty the lady is! She is damn pretty! And her song, it is excellent!”

“Stop bullshitting! Hurry up and show me the recording!” Although he said this, Sheng Wenshi still felt slightly confused in his heart. Hearing his colleague’s words, this singer should be someone new and not well known. The probability that this kind of majorly produced film would use a newcomer’s song as its theme song was so low that it made one’s hair stand on end.

But he also knew, being a music producer, that knowing all the big shots and small celebrities in the music industry was a must. Since his colleague didn’t know the name of the singer, that person had to be a newcomer in the industry.
Luckily, his colleague very quickly took out the camcorder, then removed the memory card and connected it to the computer.
The recording appeared shortly after.
It was taken in a bustling and raucous environment. At the start of the video, this scene caused Sheng Wenshi’s eyebrows to frown. Someone who sang at a place like this, how good could she be?
Sheng Wenshi was slightly suspicious. “Are you sure you are not kidding me?”
“You will understand after you finish watching the video.” His colleague was staring intently at the screen, his saliva drooping out again. “She’s coming out, she’s coming out!”

Very quickly, a young girl appeared on the stage. Her hair was let down to her waist, and her body was slender. The temperament of a pretty girl from a humble family could be felt. But before Sheng Wenshi could react, her temperament changed in a split second.
Using the commonly used words nowadays to describe, she was a receiver off stage and instantly changed into a giver. The strong contrast in temperament almost caused Sheng Wenshi’s heart to jump out.
“I dedicate this song, ‘Lightning Pursuit,’ to everyone!” the girl on stage said.

Energetic music sounded. The girl’s clear and penetrative voice was like thunder to the ears. A short three minutes flew past, causing Sheng Wenshi to become entirely astonished. After being astonished for an entire 30 seconds, Sheng Wenshi violently strangled his colleague. “Who is this lady? Tell me now! Who is she? How can I find her? Now!”
