chapters.title: Chapter 43 - Scold Me with One Sentence and I Will Kill Your Whole Family
paragraphs: “Let... let go... I am dying, I am dying... ” His colleague was strangled almost until he couldn’t breathe. “You... you are committing murder...”

Then, Sheng Wenshi changed to pressing his shoulders instead and shook him violently. “Where is this lady now? Bring me to her now! Her song is most suitable for the theme song for the movie. It’s perfect!”

His colleague took in deep breaths, panting like an old brown cow that was working on the fields. “What are you so rushed for... Huff... It’s not like I won’t tell you... Huff... How is it, this lady is not bad, right? When I listened to her sing yesterday, I immediately became her loyal fan!”

Sheng Wenshi became frantic. “Ahhh, stop talking crap! I know that you are her loyal fan, I am too! But what I am asking is how I can find her! How do I find her! Now is not the time to discuss whether you are a loyal fan or not!”

By now, his colleague had finally caught his breath. “Yesterday night, I was bored, and I heard from my friend that the Ye Lai Xiang nightclub in West Fourth Loop was entirely free, so I went. When I arrived, the crowd was spectacular... Ah, don’t rush, I am going to say it, really!” Feeling the piercing stare from Sheng Shiwen, he hurriedly said, “I will just skip the beginning. When this lady went on stage, the crowd totally erupted. She sang a total of two songs. I felt that this ‘Lightning Pursuit’ was suitable to be the theme song for the movie, so I paid special attention to her. Then, I found out that she seemed to... seemed to be... how should I say it?”
“Seemed to be what? You’re going to make me die from nervousness—is that what you want?” Sheng Wenshi was quick to be enraged. He panted heavily just from listening to his colleague.

“En, she seemed to be the mistress of a rich family’s young master, but that also didn’t seem to be the case. The young master was only about 17 or 18 years old, and their relationship didn’t seem very close. But if there is some other relationship, I couldn’t tell.” After a long-winded speech, his colleague finally concluded. “Basically, she is definitely related to that young master.”
“Who’s that young master? Did you find out?” Sheng Wenshi curiously asked.
“Of course.” His colleague pushed his glasses up his nose. “It’s Young Master Hong Dali from the Hong family. You have definitely heard of him before.”
Upon hearing this name, Sheng Wenshi almost bit off his own tongue. “Hong Dali from the Hong family? The infamous prodigal!? Where did that prodigal find this extraordinary singer?”

“How am I supposed to know that?” His colleague jabbed Sheng Wenshi’s elbow. “Hehe, Old Sheng, I heard that in two days, Young Master Hong Dali will be hosting a concert for this lady at the West Fourth Loop sports stadium. And it’ll be totally free. On that day...”

What was there to hesitate for? Sheng Wenshi immediately came to a decision. “Go, of course, we will go! I will find some more seasoned music producers to go together. Oh, right, and the company that is filming the movie, ask them along too. We shall take a good look on that day! Aiya, heaven is really on my side. Quick, play the video again! Although the effect is a little too noisy, it still sounds fantastic!”
Hong Dali slept till noon in a daze and felt quite unhappy.

The entertainment culture in this world was really too poor. It was not an exaggeration to say that if the entertainment service in his previous world was rated 100 marks, the one in this world could only be rated 50 marks. Hong Dali couldn’t find any songs worth listening to at all. Although music had no boundaries, the music that he heard always made him feel vexed as if someone was scratching his insides.

When he wanted to read a novel, the novels in this world were even more intolerable. He had gone and taken a look at the Zhong Dian website that he had bought yesterday. The novels there weren’t even readable... Visually speaking, the novels in this world were more like essays and not the kinds that were moaning about imaginary problems. Rather, they were the type that expressed emotions. The whole passage was filled with beautiful words that described an impressive scene, but they had no storyline or plot. Was this kind of novel readable? Hong Dali slept through the morning thanks to the hypnotizing effect of this stuff. After reading three chapters of the opening of a novel, he had fallen asleep immediately.
When he finally found a novel that was quite interesting, there wasn’t anything left to read after just a while...
Damn it, this is intolerable!

Hong Dali was so angry that he wanted to smash his phone on the floor. Just when he got to an important part, there were no more chapters left. He couldn’t even anticipate the remaining chapters because the author had quit. How was Hong Dali, someone who always viewed squandering as a means to change his lifestyle for the better, supposed to accept this?

Therefore, when his lunch break came, Hong Dali entered his car and directly asked Xiaoyi, “Xiaoyi, that Zhong Dian website, most of the novels there aren’t interesting at all. When I finally found one that was acceptable, the author had actually quit halfway. That made me so depressed. Help me find some authors with their own unique writing styles to write some novels with more storylines and plots. Their job is just to write novels full time.”

“Ah?” Hearing Hong Dali’s words, Ling Xiaoyi was baffled and asked, “Storyline? Shouldn’t novels always be as they are now? I thought they were quite fine when I read them occasionally. You just can’t read too many of them at once. If you do, you will get sleepy.”

“That’s exactly what I mean. These aren’t novels but hypnotizing books. I read five different novels and slept for four lessons. They are even more effective than sleeping pills.” Some of the novels in this world were similar to those light novels from a certain island country in his previous life. Hong Dali lethargically said, “The type of novel that I want isn’t like this. I want those kinds that, yep, those kinds that are filled with fighting and killing. You glare at me and I beat you up. You scold me with one sentence and I will kill your whole family. This type, are there any?”
Ling Xiaoyi was almost choked to death by Hong Dali’s words. She looked at him, stupefied, and said, “I... I will try my best... There should be something like that...”

“If there aren’t any, find some authors who write in simple language and ask them to write a few such novels for me.” Hong Dali added, “And also, the novel that I found acceptable was called something like ‘Evil Energy.’ Ask the editor to contact the author. I don’t care what he does, but make sure to get that author to continue writing the story for me to read.”
Ling Xiaoyi: “All... all right.”

“I am bored to the point of dying. Oh, right, make a copy of Sister Nianwei’s songs for me. Her songs are more to my liking.” Hong Dali leaned against the window. “And also, that Turkey Bookstore, what’s the current situation? Tell me more specifically.”

“OK.” Ling Xiaoyi immediately reported. “Turkey Bookstore is currently the largest novel database in Heavenly State. The website’s IP site traffic... is roughly 10 times that of Zhong Dian. The number of authors there is also much higher than at Zhong Dian. Currently speaking, with regards to online novels, Turkey Bookstore is dominant. Its position is very stable.”
Looks like this opponent isn’t a weak one.Hong Dali asked, “Then, how can we win against them?”
Ling Xiaoyi thought for a while, then helplessly said, “I am not very knowledgeable about operating a website. Young Master, why don’t we hold a job fair and hire some people to help us manage it?”
“En, OK. You decide the timing, and we will hold a job fair then.” Hong Dali immediately decided.
“OK, Young Master, I got it.” Ling Xiaoyi carefully asked. “Young Master, are you really planning to compete directly with Liu Mingcheng?”

“Do you still need to ask?” Hong Dali calmly said. “Our relationship isn’t good anyway. We will have to fight each other sooner or later. The one who strikes first will gain the upper hand, right, haha. There’s an old saying that is very suitable: those with the means should squander, those without the means should create the means to grab someone to squander with!”

chapters.title: Chapter 44 - Unexpectedly, Dali Creates Miracles
paragraphs: It was all calm for the next few days. The tasks that Hong Dali had arranged were impossible to complete in a day or two. The only thing that progressed was Caiwei Entertainment—with Hong Dali the superprodigal backing the company, all that was needed for it to run smoothly was money. Caiwei Entertainment was impressively set up at the speed of light.
Although it was a small-scale company—incomparable to a regular media company—it had everything that one would expect to find. The only thing it lacked was talented actors and singers.
That was the only piece of good news for Hong Dali over the past few mundane days.

Hong Dali had been visiting Ye Lai Xiang with his lackeys along with the dogs for the past three days. By opening the nightclub for free and with other squandering methods, he had only managed to squander some 400,000 yuan—only enough to redeem four attribute points to increase his health stat to 80.
Hong Dali was not satisfied with the progress.

It was neither easy nor difficult to squander in this world. For example, the investment science team had launched the perpetual-motion machine. Investing a few million yuan, or even hundreds of million were just putting it in jeopardy. Hong Dali might be a prodigal, but he was not so stupid as to invest in something like that.
Or he could buy luxury items. But that didn’t work for Hong Dali since he was already decked in luxury items. Owning one more or one less wouldn’t make a difference.
As such, there was nothing much Hong Dali could do to squander.

Hence, once Caiwei Entertainment opened its doors, Hong Dali brought Tang Muxin to inspect the place and explore how to make movies. With such an ideal situation, it would be a pity not to make any movies.
Together with Tang Muxin and the nine lackeys behind him, Hong Dali made his flashy entrance into the ninth floor of the Chenhui Building.

The Chenhui Building now belonged to Hong Dali. He was downright a local tyrant, doing whatever he wanted. The group of people entered the building in a formidable array. Once through the doors, they saw the manager, Zhang Cai, instructing the workers. “That way, place the items properly and neatly. Be careful, these are important props that will be useful in the future. Don’t damage them, they’re very expensive!”
Hong Dali walked forward with Tang Muxin, smiling as he asked, “Sister Zhang, how’s the progress? Is it ready for us to make movies? The environment here is good, right?”

Zhang Cai greeted them joyously. “Yes, Young Master, hello, Young Master! Hello, Young Madam!” They were her saviors and the source of all the money. Zhang Cai reported to Hong Dali, “I’m a layman in the aspects of helping out in the company, but I’m doing as much as I can. I have nothing to do anyway, the least I can do is to help out and inspect the place. At present, we have found the directors, producers, cameramen, and the people in charge of the lighting. Once the renovation is complete, they will be able to report for work.”

“Um, not bad!” Hong Dali looked around the place like the leader of a country visiting the countryside. The place was rather big, almost 3,000 square kilometers. He nodded his head in agreement. “Sister Zhang, how long do you think before we can start filming movies? It doesn’t seem like a bad idea to squander through making movies. I like it.”

Zhang Cai paused for a moment. Should she support Hong Dali’s squandering? If she supported him, Hong Dali might not say anything when he invested and lost money, but she would definitely be deemed incompetent. If she did not support him, wouldn’t she be a wet blanket? She was a 33-year-old adult. It paid to be smart. “Young Master, we should need another week before we can start any filming. We have the equipment ready. The problem is finding good actors. I know many famous actors already have a full schedule. They won’t be able to commit on such short notice. If we engage actors that are not famous, they will not be worthy of you, Young Master.”
Just so, she’d had to say something anyway. In short, the conclusion was that it’d take a while before any filming could start.

Tang Muxin had never liked Hong Dali squandering. She commented decisively, “That’s right. Dali, we should wait if it’s not ready. Observe the situation. If the cast is not great, nobody will want to watch it.”

But Hong Dali had his tasks from the great prodigal system waiting. He could not afford to wait. “That’s easy. We can look for actors. Oh yes, are there professionals in 3D animation? We can make animations if there aren’t any actors!”

“3D animations?” Zhang Cai shook her head. “It’s too tough to find professionals like that. A good team would cost a lot. Young Master may be rich, but the problem is the lack of opportunity. The teams that can provide 3D effects for movies are all working for big movie or gaming companies. Our company is newly set up. It will not be easy to attract such talents to join us.” To put it bluntly, money couldn’t buy what was not available.
Hong Dali rubbed his chin after hearing what Zhang Cai said. “Um, that seems like a problem. When I come back with a script, let’s find a few people to act it out. This should be simple.”
Tang Muxin was shocked when she heard Hong Dali. “You’re writing a script?! You can write scripts? Don’t tell me it’s a script about squandering? Squandering stories?”

Hong Dali was slightly dissatisfied with Tang Muxin’s response. “Can you have a little confidence in me? Brother Dali here does not only know how to squander. I can be quite creative. Say, squandering by rearing dogs, even you could not think of something like that.”
Tang Muxin angrily pouted. “Of course not! Only a lunatic could think of something like that...”

Hong Dali laughed. “You can’t do it, right? Beneath the surface of my squandering, a genius exists. It’s just a movie script. I could think of it any minute. Heh Heh. You’ll be scared to death when you hear it!”
Tang Muxin was not to be outdone. “Tell me about it. What kind of script are you thinking of writing? I would really like to hear what could scare me to death!”

Coming from 21st-century Earth, even if he had never learned cinematography, he was not short of ideas—and these ideas had been successful on Earth! Hong Dali confidently spread out his arms, exclaiming. “I’m the king of movies! The movie that I want to make is a sitcom micro movie! It will be called‘Unexpectedly, Dali Creates Miracles’!”

chapters.title: Chapter 45 - Embarking on the Pinnacle of Life
paragraphs: “Sitcom your head!” If not for Hong Dali’s poor health, Tang Muxin really wanted to punch Hong Dali. “WhatUnexpectedly, Dali creates Miracles? I really want you to experience what a flying disaster is. It must be unexpected that my fist is so strong!”

Unexpectedlywas a comedy sitcom back on Hong Dali’s Earth. It hadn’t cost much to produce the show, yet viewership ratings had been high. It was a micro movie that had shot to fame at rocket speed. A small investment with high returns. Hong Dali was almost confident that if he could recreate it, it would definitely become popular, measuring by the standards of this world.

There was a little problem, though. Hong Dali’s goal was to squander. He would not be able to gain attribute points if he did not squander. Without the attribute points, his health stat would not grow. Without health, his penis would not become bigger. He quickly changed his stance. Hong Dali rubbed his chin and said, “Um, what I said was just child’s play. The whole sitcom will only cost about 10,000 yuan to produce. No way, we need to do something else.”
“Child’s play,””whole sitcom,””only cost about 10,000 yuan.”

These few keywords caused Tang Muxin’s eyes to brighten. It was her turn to be shocked. “Dali, you said it would only cost 10,000 yuan to produce the whole sitcom? Are you serious? Are you lying to me?”

Hong Dali curiously replied, “It’s true. Why would I lie to you? The cost of producing a comedy is very low. The filming location is more or less fixed. The scenes don’t require much editing. The important thing is that people enjoy watching it.”

Hong Dali was just casually talking about the sitcom as he thought about it, but a casual remark ignited the interest of a listener. Tang Muxin became interested in the idea. “Dali, you mentioned ‘Unexpectedly,’ and ‘Dali Creates Miracles.’ Explain it to me, please?”

Why had this lass suddenly taken an interest in this? Hong Dali was perplexed. “Why? Are you interested? Do you want to be the main actress? With my Xinxin’s figure and beauty, you’d be invincible as the lead actress. How about I become the lead actor, then?”

With Hong Dali’s status, it only seemed right to invest tens of millions or even billions. But he did not have so much money with him, and it would be impossible to come up with so much money at once.TransformersandIron Manwere out. He was left withUnexpectedly. Since it had piqued Tang Muxin’s interest, there was no harm in explaining it to her.
If she is willing to be the lead actress, I’ll settle with being the lead actor forUnexpectedly, Wang Dachui. Dear Chuichui. Um, Hong Dali, Wang Dachui, these two names seem to rhyme too.

Tang Muxin was a young girl, after all. She was only 18, the same age as Hong Dali. It was no surprise that she’d be interested in movies. Since Hong Dali was willing to squander, and the investment was minimal, she was willing to play along with it. “Okay, okay. I’ll be the lead actress. Dali, you can be the lead actor!” Whether the production would make money—it is just a sitcom worth over ten thousand—what profit could there be?

Hong Dali agreed immediately. “Ummh!” Hearing what Tang Muxin had said, Hong Dali was more than happy to play along. He could squander anytime, but it was rare that Tang Muxin was willing to play with him. He started to act out the famous lines inUnexpectedly. “My name is Wang Dachui. Unexpectedly, I got promoted with a pay raise. I became the general manager, then I became the CEO. I married a fair, rich, and beautiful lady and embarked on the peak of my life!”

Hong Dali was quite good looking, but he was slightly dorky in nature. To act out those lines in all seriousness, everyone around started to shake with laughter. Tang Muxin could not straighten her slender waist from laughing too hard. “Dali, I didn’t realize you had such a great sense of humor. Why did that sound so funny coming from you?”
Zhang Cai roared with laughter too. “Young Master, you look so funny all solemn like this.”

Ling Xiaoyi turned around in an attempt to hide her laughter. “This young master is like a comedian. He could make people laugh just by randomly saying something. If he manages to produce the sitcom, the viewership ratings will surely go through the roof.”

Everyone was rolling on the floor laughing. When Tang Muxin approached Hong Dali for the script, a gentle voice came from behind her. “Ah, the young master is here. Hello, Young Master. Hello, Young Madam.”

Hong Dali turned to see a lady in a white tube-top dress with delicate lace lining. The lace brought attention to her fair legs—long and straight, outlining the curves of her calves. Her unaccessorized dark hair fell over her shoulders and ears. The tiny piercing on her fair and soft ears was vaguely visible through her hair. She always had a faint smile on her face, looking bright-eyed.
To make such an impactful entrance, it could only be the girl who had given Caiwei Entertainment half its name, Hong Dali’s newly acquired employee: Li Nianwei.
Hong Dali snorted. “Sister Nianwei!” He threw himself toward Li Nianwei, putting his hand around her delicate waist, and rubbed his head against her chest. “Sister Nianwei, you are here! Save me!”
Tang Muxin had initially felt a pang of jealousy, seeing Hong Dali hug Li Nianwei. However, she was stunned when she heard what Hong Dali said.
Hong Dali was not in any danger. Why had he asked Li Nianwei to save him?

While she pondered, Hong Dali bawled. “I can’t take any more of these lousy songs. I can’t find any of Sister Nianwei’s songs. I’ve been doing nothing but sleeping these days. I want to listen to songs. I want to produce movies. I want to squander! Sister Nianwei, let’s record an album for you. I want to make a few hundred thousand albums and listen to them over and over again!”
Hong Dali was truly on a roll!

Li Nianwei laughed as she spoke to Hong Dali, like an elder sister speaking to a little brother who adored her. “Young Master, don’t get so worked up. You can tell me anytime if you want to listen to my songs. I brought my songs today. You can make a copy if you wish.”

Aiya, now that Hong Dali had taken the opportunity to have a feel of Li Nianwei’s chest, as well as get a hold of the songs, he was content. “Um, okay. I will make a copy.” He instructed a female lackey behind him. “Make a copy of the songs and store them in my cell phone so I can listen to them in class.”
“Yes, Young Master.” The lackey carefully took the luxury cell phone worth 125,000 yuan from Hong Dali and turned around to leave.
Hong Dali snorted again. “Sister Nianwei, how are the preparations for the concert coming along? Is everything running smoothly?”

chapters.title: Chapter 46 - Dali Is Actually Blushing
paragraphs: Li Nianwei had the most blissful and contented smile on her face as she softly said, “Um, all is good. Young Master, thank you. It has always been my dream to be able to hold a concert. Now, I can finally fulfill my dream.” She stepped back as she spoke and bowed deeply toward Hong Dali.
To Li Nianwei, becoming a superstar and earning lots of money was not important. All she wanted was to be known for her talent and for her songs to be liked. That would be sufficient.

Hong Dali had helped her achieve the first step toward her dream. Not everyone could hold a concert. That required lots of manpower, resources, and money. Even with all those in place, she needed the fame.
Li Nianwei was not famous yet. But in Hong Dali’s eyes, that was not a problem.
The people in Heavenly State loved anything that was fun, more so if it were free. To be able to watch a free concert on a long, sleepless night, what could be more pleasing than that?
The most difficult factor in holding a concert was the easiest one for Hong Dali—his purpose was to squander, to spend money. It was not his concern about whether the concert made money or not.

Hong Dali flicked his hair and laughed. “Aiya, don’t stand on ceremony. Ahahahaha! I just want to squander. It’s just a matter of how the money is spent. It makes me happy to spend money on this matter, so there’s no need to thank me. Ah, haha, haha!”
From a young age, he had rarely been thanked by anyone in this manner. He didn’t know what to do.
Tang Muxin stared at Hong Dali’s face. She giggled as she said, “Dali, you are actually blushing! The sun must be rising from the west. You are usually so thick-skinned.”

“No matter how thick, it is still made of flesh. It is normal to be a little red.” Hong Dali coughed and asked Ling Xiaoyi, who was standing beside him. “Xiaoyi, regarding the concert, how is the progress of the construction of the venue?”
Ling Xiaoyi responded respectfully, “Young Master, everything is smoothly going as you planned.”
Um, that’s good.Hong Dali rubbed his chin and said, “Okay. Everyone is free to go around on their own. I’m thirsty. We’ll continue after I have a drink.”
“Yes.”
“Okay.”

As Hong Dali had instructed, everyone acted accordingly. Very soon, only Ling Xiaoyi was left beside him. Hong Dali called out the great prodigal system in his mind and looked at the numbers there. When he saw them, he beamed with joy. Current squandering value: 2,051,874 yuan.
Two million! Wahahahahaha! One concert was worth two million yuan. Cool!

Everyone was afraid of losing money by holding concerts, afraid that not enough people would attend, afraid that the money made could not cover the costs. Hong Dali was most afraid of not squandering enough. Then, his attribute points would not increase...
Without another word or thought, he added all the attribute points to his health stat.

From Hong Dali’s view, he could see himself glistering in golden light. Just like when the veterans in novels advanced to the next level, the glistering lasted for a whole 30 seconds before it started to dim down.
Aiya, that was comfortable. Too damn comfortable!

Hong Dali stretched himself. Every cell in his body was crying for joy. Only a perfectly healthy person would feel this. So this was how it felt when the health stat was perfect. Without exaggerating, Hong Dali felt as healthy as a newborn baby—with the ability to absorb the world’s energy. That was how it felt, generally speaking.

The voice from the system resounded in his mind: “Health stat of the host has reached 100 points, full points. When host’s five stats have reached full points, the system will be upgraded. Small prodigal will be upgraded to big prodigal.”
This was only the system for small prodigals? What was it like for big prodigals?
Forget it, this was not the time to think about this. It was a very happy day.

Troubles never came together, while fortune never came alone. With his health stat full, the next thing was to increase his sexual ability. This was what Hong Dali cared about the most. Without sexual ability, how could he be a man?
Strength and reflexes could wait. They were not important. He wasn’t about to pick a fight with anyone anyway.
I want to spend lavishly! I want to squander! I want to increase my sexual ability! I want the small penis to become big!
Qian Ge Headquarters Building, Tianjing City Central, Level 16.

The secretary stood in Hong Weiguo’s office, reporting the development updates for West Four Loops. “CEO Hong, the development for West Four Loops is going smoothly. Fengyuan Lake and the mountain have been approved. In another week’s time, they will be under Young Master Dali’s name. The Chenhui Building’s acquisition is almost completed. The cleanup for the three plots of land purchased previously has started and is progressing quickly.”

Hong Weiguo grinned as he drank his tea. “Um, good job.” Ever since Hong Weiguo found out that Hong Dali’s health had improved, his mood had been beautiful. No less than when he had just started dating his wife, Lan Ruoxi.
The secretary continued, “At the moment, the blueprint planning for the three plots of land has begun, but it has yet to be finalized.”

He rubbed his chin as he spoke to himself. “This is a good place, but I can’t be too careless if I want to develop this place.”

What did Dali say he wanted to do near Fengyuan Lake? I was busy that day and didn’t get a chance to ask him myself. Have you asked him as I instructed?”

The secretary was sweating profusely as she answered, “Young Master said... Young Master said...” He paused for a moment, then decisively said, “Young Master said he wanted to build a village there and be like the Marshes of Mount Liang, to be the king of the mountain...”

Hong Weiguo burst out laughing. “Haha, this rascal. How did he come up with such an idea? Um, let me think...” He looked at the map again, and his eyes lit up. He drew a curve on the map. “This place is not very far from Tianjing Mountain...”

Hong Weiguo suddenly shouted, “Xiao Zhao, pass down my instructions at once. Contact the Land and Resources Bureau and ask if anyone owns the land near Tianjing Mountain and Fengyuan Lake. If no one owns it, think of how to purchase these few mountains!”

chapters.title: Chapter 47 - The Start of the Concert
paragraphs: Saturday, April 26, 2014
At 7:30 PM, the two-kilometer radius surrounding West Four Loops Stadium was closely packed with people and cars.

The traffic police had put up barricades in an attempt to direct the traffic to another route, with every policeman and security officer trying their best to maintain order. Thousands, tens of thousands of young men and women were swinging their light sticks, waiting to enter the concert venue. The noise was so deafening that it shook the leaves of the trees along the streets.
There were still many people desperately squeezing their way through. At a glance, only the people’s heads could be seen. The pungent smell of sweat lingered in the air.

The policeman shouted into the loudspeaker: “Keep quiet, everyone, keep quiet. Those that are here to attend the concert, you may collect your ticket from the ticket-sales counter. Admission to the concert will be verified via ticket. Please seat yourself according to the assigned seat number on your ticket. Don’t go to the wrong seat!”

The main reason why so many people had turned up was the element of surprise during the publicity for the concert—a mysterious singer, a mysterious stage, mysterious lights, and a mysterious backdrop.

Everything was so mysterious. The people who came were not sure what kind of concert it was going to be. One thing that was for certain was: the news leaked from various sources was that this was not an ordinary concert. One would definitely regret it if they didn’t attend. There was also insider news that the singer was exceptionally beautiful and that her songs were exceptionally pleasing to the ear.
A beautiful singer that sang beautiful songs, as well as a free concert—who would miss it?
The impact caused by tens of thousands of people attending the concert was far beyond expectations.

The crowd was at its peak when Sheng Wenshi arrived with seven or eight well-known people from within the industry. The number of young men and women in the stadium was increasing. Everyone was excited, pushing each other in order to gain a little more space. There was a nervous-looking policeman maintaining order between every two or three meters. Such a scene was rare. Where had this mysterious singer come from? How had she been able to attract such a crowd?
Unbeknown to them, all this was only due to one word: “free.”

A free concert was irresistible. It took Sheng Wenshi and the others a lot of effort before they managed to make their way through to speak to an officer. Sheng Wenshi took out his identification from his shirt pocket and tried to attract the officer’s attention by waving it, but it took a while before the officer noticed him. “How can I help you?”

Sheng Wenshi anxiously said, “We’re veteran music producers. I’m Sheng Wenshi. I’m in charge of Kuge Music Recommended Songs Chart. These are our good friends from the industry. We came here specifically because we heard there is a very talented singer holding a concert here today. Would you let us pass?”
This person was from Kuge Music and had a huge amount of resources on hand. The officer did not dare to treat him shabbily. He softly said, “Please wait for a while. I will check with my boss.”
In an instant, the officer came running back and cautiously said, “Please follow me and try not to attract too much attention; maintain low key.”

Sheng Wenshi and the rest had been in the industry for many years and had never been asked to stay low key and not attract too much attention. They were used to impressing everyone with their authority and experience. Those that invited them were only afraid of them not getting enough exposure. Who would think that they would have to sneakily enter the concert venue in this manner? But they could only bear with it, keeping in mind that the organizer was the famous superprodigal—there was nothing they could do, as they were not as influential.
Without much effort to get the VIP tickets to enter the venue, the stadium was already filled to the brim.

Ling Xiaoyi had prepared VIP tickets in advance in case anyone important showed up. They were front-row seats, only two meters away from the stairs in the center of the stage. There were two or three people on stage testing the sound system, as it was not yet time for the concert to start.
Sheng Wenshi had just sat down when he was shocked by the strange sights at the scene. “Aye, w-what is this?”

Normally, the lighting would have been adjusted. But the concert venue was pitch black. The huge stage was barely visible, with not a single ray of light escaping from the back. It felt strange all around.

“Old Sheng, is this venue incomplete? Why are there so many cranes at the side? And metal scaffoldings too. What’s going on?” A middle-aged man nudged Sheng Wenshi. “Why does this concert feel so strange all around?”

Sheng Wenshi could not understand the situation either. He wiped the sweat from his forehead and whispered. “I feel that way too. Look around. One, two, three, four... there are at least 10 cranes. Even if the construction of the stage has not finished, there shouldn’t be so many cranes. Also, what’s the purpose of the slopes there? It is all too strange.”
They looked all around but could not understand the situation they were in.

The people at the stadium kept increasing. They turned around and saw only people’s heads. They were all veterans in the music industry and had attended countless concerts. At a glance, they estimated there were around 30,000 people.

Sheng Wenshi shook his head. “This scene is really...” He started to get excited about the concert. “This singer’s appeal is really big. I remember it was at least 5 or 6 years ago when we last encountered a scene so big.”

The man with the beard nodded. “Um, it was five years ago at Queen Wei Fangfang’s concert. There were at least 35,000 people. No one was able to draw such a huge crowd after that. Aye, Old Sheng, do you think the singer today is as competent?”
Another man in glasses smiled. “I think it’s because it’s free. If the concert cost money, the scene might not be the same.”
“True.” Sheng Wenshi smiled and said, “It should start soon. Come, let’s watch now.”

It was like his words cued the start of the concert as the lights shone on the whole stadium except the center of the stage. The sound of rain slowly filled up the stadium, and a slender lady emerged and stood on the stage.
The lady stood in complete darkness. One could see her figure from the faint light coming from behind her.
A slender, elegant, figure with the golden ratio. She was flawless.
“She’s here, she’s here!” Sheng Wenshi could feel his heartbeat increasing as he started praising the lady. “Without looking at the rest, just this shadow has made today’s trip worthwhile!”

While the crowd was nodding their heads in agreement, the sound of an engine starting could be heard. Two black Soaring Angel stretch limousines drove slowly into the stadium, and each limousine had a black Prayer Angel following behind it. Behind each Prayer Angels was a Gentley sports car on each side. And behind each Gentley was a Zinney sports car worth at least 600,000 yuan followed by an Azma sports car, also worth 600,000 yuan.

chapters.title: Chapter 48 - Superprodigal
paragraphs: With a Soaring Angel taking the lead, the sports cars drove one by one toward the center of the stadium. Sheng Wenshi did a quick count and was almost speechless. “Oh my god. Th... th... there must be at least 40 sports cars here. Just the cars add up to almost 30 million yuan!”
The bearded man sighed. “A prodigal! He is indeed a prodigal! This Hong Dali spent so much just to create this entrance. I’ve got to hand it to him.”
With all the commotion on stage, along with 40 sports cars, the crowd started to cheer while swinging their light sticks, lighting up the dark night sky.

It wasn’t that these people had not seen sports cards. This was just their first time seeing so many sports cars at once. Especially the Soaring Angels leading the fleet. That cost more than four million yuan. A normal person might not even have the chance to see a real Soaring Angel once in their life, not to mention two at once. How could the crowd not go crazy?
In an instant, the audience grew even more curious about the identity of the singer. Where had she come from?
Little could they know that this extravagant lineup had been specially arranged by Hong Dali just so he could squander.

The two Soaring Angels started to drive around the stage along with the fleet of 40 sports cars. After going around the stage twice, the Soaring Angels started driving up the slope behind the stage. All 40 sports cars started to drive up the different slopes at different angles. Some slopes were elevated at 10 degrees, some 20, some 30. Those cars with low bumpers drove up the steel plates on the stage. The cranes started to lift these cars into the air.

Sheng Wenshi was dumbfounded. “Wh-what is this situation?” The bearded man was stunned. There was silence in the concert venue. Everyone was trying to understand the situation and the intent of the organizer.
Soon after, the crowd went crazy.
The headlights of the Soaring Angels suddenly switched on, followed by the headlights of the Prayer Angels. All the other sports cars’ high-beam headlights and fog lights were switched on too...
All the lights shone on a single spot—on Li Nianwei, the singer standing in the middle of the stage.

Li Nianwei was wearing a simple red and white striped short-sleeved top. Its collar and sleeves were black. The workmanship was extremely fine, making her look petite. The round collar revealed her beautiful collarbone. Light-blue shorts lay above her fair and slender thighs. Her black low-cut boots were simple and elegant. The thin red bangles on her left hand shone with the reflection of the headlights.

Her face was a classical oval shape, only slightly bigger than a man’s palm. She looked so perfect—it was as though she had walked out from a manga. Different from the big eyes that a typical beautiful woman had, her eyes were big, bright, and shiny. There was also a tinge of sadness in her eyes. It was like she was pouring her heart out. Her nose was tall and straight, and her thin, soft cherry lips looked intoxicating in ruby red. Two silver rings hung from her fair earlobes. Her long black hair flowed like a waterfall, falling onto her slender shoulders.
She was a beauty indeed. No one would think otherwise.
The stage was truly luxurious and beautifully decorated. The light behind her was so dazzling and shocking to the crowd that they were all dumbfounded and speechless.

“Oh my god...” Sheng Wenshi almost drowned in his own saliva. “Such a shocking opening to the concert. How did the prodigal come up with this? To use the headlines of cars worth 30 million yuan to provide lighting for the stage?!”

The bearded man muttered. “It’s the superprodigal! I was darn right to come today. One might not even have the chance to encounter such a scene once in their life! To use the headlights of more than 40 luxury cars as stage lighting, can I point my middle finger at God? Heck, is he even in the same world as me!?” He couldn’t help but curse even though he usually liked to put up a front.
We all belong to the same world. How is the gap between our worlds so vast?

After the brief shock, his whole body felt weak. “I’m really impressed. This superprodigal... I’m impressed... I never knew such art could emerge from squandering. I must be looking at it from the wrong angle. I must be!”
Li Nianwei had not yet started to sing, but the crowd was nearly out of control.

The perfect lineup, out-of-the-world extravagance, and an extremely beautiful lady. Everything seemed like it was proving to the crowd that they had made the right choice in attending this concert. This concert would definitely be a topic worth talking about for a lifetime.

At this moment, the audience had gone completely bonkers without even hearing Li Nianwei sing. They might not know her name yet, but they knew this beautiful lady who had emerged from such a beautiful scene would definitely make a name for herself in the entertainment industry. In the whole world, only she would be worthy enough to stand at the peak.
Goddess! She’s a goddess!
This thought flashed through everyone’s mind.
“Engrave, between each eyebrow, upon the heart. Between every stroke, filled with ruminating thoughts. Soaked, the color of ink flows. Thousand CharactersClassic1, have all turned yellow...”

Hong Dali had specifically visited Caiwei Entertainment to write this song, “Rolling up the Beaded Curtain,” for Li Nianwei as the opening song. The song was pleasing to the ear. The melody was euphemistic and lingering, glamorous without being kitsch, and intoxicatingly charming. The song reverberated within the stadium. It was as though the stars had lost their glimmer, and all that was left was Li Nianwei’s voice. There was only one word to describe her voice: heavenly.
Sheng Wenshi and his companions were completely mesmerized. The melody lingered in their minds.

The bearded man was carefully evaluating the lyrics in his mind.Engrave, between each eyebrow, upon the heart—the main character is a beautiful lady, and she is drawing her lover. In the olden days, people referred “mustache and brows” to men. There is also the saying about “A man’s brow and a woman’s skin”—whether a man is good looking depends on the aura between the brows. The lover of the main character should be quite good looking. She misses her lover with every line she draws that makes up the brow.
“Between every stroke, filled with ruminating thoughts”—she thinks back on their beautiful memories from when they were together.

“Soaked, the color of ink flows. Thousand Characters Classic have all turned yellow...”—the people of the olden days used ink for drawing. This lady should be a talented person in all aspects—music, wit, intelligence, and art. The drawing she drew of her lover out of yearning fully depicts her lover’s charisma and good looks. Her longing for her lover is all over the drawing. Even the longing wrote inThousand Characters Classic—by thousands and tens of thousands of famous poets—cannot be compared to her drawing.
“Good song. Good tune. Good lyrics. Good singer!”

Her black low-cut boots were simple and elegant.
The thin red bangles on her left hand shone with the reflection of the headlights.
Her face was a classical oval shape, only slightly bigger than a man’s palm.
She looked so perfect—it was as though she had walked out from a manga.
Different from the big eyes that a typical beautiful woman had, her eyes were big, bright, and shiny.
There was also a tinge of sadness in her eyes.
It was like she was pouring her heart out.
Her nose was tall and straight, and her thin, soft cherry lips looked intoxicating in ruby red.
Two silver rings hung from her fair earlobes.
Her long black hair flowed like a waterfall, falling onto her slender shoulders.
She was a beauty indeed.
No one would think otherwise.
The stage was truly luxurious and beautifully decorated.
The light behind her was so dazzling and shocking to the crowd that they were all dumbfounded and speechless.
“Oh my god...” Sheng Wenshi almost drowned in his own saliva.
“Such a shocking opening to the concert.
How did the prodigal come up with this?
To use the headlines of cars worth 30 million yuan to provide lighting for the stage?!”
The bearded man muttered.
“It’s the superprodigal!
I was darn right to come today.
One might not even have the chance to encounter such a scene once in their life!
To use the headlights of more than 40 luxury cars as stage lighting, can I point my middle finger at God?
Heck, is he even in the same world as me!?” He couldn’t help but curse even though he usually liked to put up a front.
We all belong to the same world.
How is the gap between our worlds so vast?
After the brief shock, his whole body felt weak.
“I’m really impressed.
This superprodigal...
I’m impressed...
I never knew such art could emerge from squandering.
I must be looking at it from the wrong angle.
I must be!”
Li Nianwei had not yet started to sing, but the crowd was nearly out of control.
The perfect lineup, out-of-the-world extravagance, and an extremely beautiful lady.
Everything seemed like it was proving to the crowd that they had made the right choice in attending this concert.
This concert would definitely be a topic worth talking about for a lifetime.
At this moment, the audience had gone completely bonkers without even hearing Li Nianwei sing.
They might not know her name yet, but they knew this beautiful lady who had emerged from such a beautiful scene would definitely make a name for herself in the entertainment industry.
In the whole world, only she would be worthy enough to stand at the peak.
Goddess!
She’s a goddess!
This thought flashed through everyone’s mind.
“Engrave, between each eyebrow, upon the heart.
Between every stroke, filled with ruminating thoughts.
Soaked, the color of ink flows.
Thousand CharactersClassic1, have all turned yellow...”
Hong Dali had specifically visited Caiwei Entertainment to write this song, “Rolling up the Beaded Curtain,” for Li Nianwei as the opening song.
The song was pleasing to the ear.
The melody was euphemistic and lingering, glamorous without being kitsch, and intoxicatingly charming.
The song reverberated within the stadium.
It was as though the stars had lost their glimmer, and all that was left was Li Nianwei’s voice.
There was only one word to describe her voice: heavenly.
Sheng Wenshi and his companions were completely mesmerized.
The melody lingered in their minds.
The bearded man was carefully evaluating the lyrics in his mind.Engrave, between each eyebrow, upon the heart—the main character is a beautiful lady, and she is drawing her lover.
In the olden days, people referred “mustache and brows” to men.
There is also the saying about “A man’s brow and a woman’s skin”—whether a man is good looking depends on the aura between the brows.
The lover of the main character should be quite good looking.
She misses her lover with every line she draws that makes up the brow.
“Between every stroke, filled with ruminating thoughts”—she thinks back on their beautiful memories from when they were together.
“Soaked, the color of ink flows.
Thousand Characters Classic have all turned yellow...”—the people of the olden days used ink for drawing.
This lady should be a talented person in all aspects—music, wit, intelligence, and art.
The drawing she drew of her lover out of yearning fully depicts her lover’s charisma and good looks.
Her longing for her lover is all over the drawing.
Even the longing wrote inThousand Characters Classic—by thousands and tens of thousands of famous poets—cannot be compared to her drawing.
“Good song.
Good tune.
Good lyrics.
Good singer!”

chapters.title: Chapter 49 - Laser Show
paragraphs: Everyone was completely shocked. They had never heard a voice like this. It was like a drop of pure, untainted water touching everyone’s heart. The pureness of the sound made one quiver.

The young men and women who had come to attend the concert were beyond excited. Their cheering and screaming fused together. If sounds were a tangible substance, the stadium would have been leveled to the ground, and it would not have been just one instance. But their cheers were buried beneath Li Nianwei’s clean and crisp voice.
The gentle, lingering voice reverberated.

Hong Dali and his classmates were merrily laughing in the stadium’s VIP room. Looking at the scene outside, Ling Yi laughed a hearty laugh. “Brother Dali, you’re the best. How did you come up with such a good idea? That instant when our cars were driven to the stage, the crowd went crazy. Haha, look at how stunned they look. It’s cool!”

Du Xinzhen eloquently said, “I knew at the tips of my fingers that Sister Nianwei would make it big! That day at the nightclub, her voice almost took my soul away. It sounds amazing. With today’s ambiance, it feels too good!”

Tang Muxin quietly observed as she thought, Dali’s luck is really good. A singer that he so easily took under his wing has such ability. Sister Ling Xiaoyi is so capable when it comes to managing stuff, and Li Nianwei is so capable as well. The gods must really favor Dali.

At this moment, Tang Muxin couldn’t help but blush. She stole a peek at Hong Dali. Hong Dali was nonchalantly drinking his beverage and watching the concert and teasing the Samoyed in his arms from time to time, grinning. “Squandering is a skill. Y’all wouldn’t understand.”
The Samoyed was happily snapping at her panda Chow Chow, Xiao Xiaobai.
Lang Hao, who always loved to go against Hong Dali, conceded defeat in his heart. He could not help but say, “It’s nothing extraordinary, playing such tricks. I could do that too.”
In unison, the surrounding classmates said, “Shut up!”
Thankfully, they were in the VIP room. If the crazy fans had heard Lang Han, he would have been dragged out and beaten up.

Standing in the middle of the stage, Li Nianwei no longer had the gentle shyness she had portrayed earlier in front of Hong Dali at Caiwei Entertainment. She was a queen on the stage, glowing with radiance and radiating with power and vitality. She was charming like a goddess. The stage was her life. Being admired by tens of thousands of people was her calling.

With the first song coming to an end, the applause was deafening. Countless young men and women cheered as they jumped for joy, shaking their light sticks quite hard, as though they wanted the light sticks to turn into powder.

Li Nianwei bowed slightly and said, “My name is Li Nianwei. I’m very touched that everyone could come to my concert tonight. Thank you all. You are my best friends. The next song, ‘Lightning Pursuit,’ was written by me. I hope everyone will like it.” Li Nianwei suddenly turned toward Hong Dali’s direction with tears in her eyes. She softly said, “Thank you, Young Master, for giving me this chance. Today will be the happiest day of my life.”
“Young Master? Who is this ‘Young Master’?” the audience wondered.

Sheng Wenshi knew more people from the upper classes and came to a conclusion very quickly. “Young Master? Is she referring to the superprodigal Hong Dali? Now that we finally know her name is Li Nianwei, I wonder how she is related to Hong Dali. Fiancée?”
The bearded man started mumbling to himself. “Li Nianwei. Um, not bad. From what I understand, Hong Dali is only 18 years old. I don’t think she is Hong Dali’s girlfriend. I hope not... um.”

The intense music promptly started. Sheng Wenshi threw all thoughts aside and started shouting. “This is the tune! This is the song! Quick, listen. This is the song I said is suitable as the theme song forWind Pursuer.”
The headlights of the sports car on the stage started flashing. Forty sports cars, all in different angles, created a light show.
The audience was screaming nonstop before the song even started.

This song was completely different from the first song, “Rolling up the Beaded Curtain,” possibly even better. Li Nianwei looked like she had emerged from the thunder or lightning. The song shocked the hearts of the audience, and they were all mesmerized. There was fog coming out from behind the stage in tune with the different highs and lows of the song.
Hong Dali had not spent two million yuan on the concert for nothing.

The sound system was worth 500,000 yuan. The impressive orchestra on both sides of the stage matched the worth of Hong Dali—there was no way a real prodigal could use the accompanying tape for the concert.
On the stage, Li Nianwei’s charisma was like a 30-kilometer-per-hour hurricane. The screaming audience did not affect her voice one bit.
At this instant, a lady broke free from the security guards and jumped on stage with a bouquet of red roses.

Li Nianwei could not take the bouquet from the lady in the midst of her performance, but the lady didn’t seem to mind. She placed the red roses on the stage and gave Li Nianwei a flying kiss before leaving the stage.

One after another, those who had been in a rush to attend the concert and had not prepared flowers left their light sticks on the stage. Within a short span of time, the security officers were overwhelmed by the number of audience members rushing up the stage to present their light sticks to Li Nianwei. When the song ended, there was a sea of light sticks on the stage—assuring Hong Dali that even if the headlights of the sports cars went off, there would not be a single dark spot on the stage.

When the second song was coming to an end, the enthusiasm of the audience had reached its peak. Sheng Wenshi and his companions, who were sitting in the VIP area, kept wiping the sweat from their foreheads. Sheng Wenshi prayed with all his might, Don’t get too excited. Don’t get too excited! I want to live for another two years. Don’t be impulsive. There is sure to be a stampede if everyone rushes to the front!
During the interval, Li Nianwei looked at Hong Dali. She was tearing up from the overwhelming euphoria.
To be able to meet Young Master Hong Dali in my life, it has all been worth it.

chapters.title: Chapter 50 - Comrade, You Have Worked Hard!
paragraphs: As the music producer ofWind Pursuer, Ding Chengzhi had been dragged to this concert held by an unknown singer by Sheng Wenshi. Subconsciously, he had thought that this would be a waste of time.

Although Sheng Wenshi had praised this singer to the skies, the entertainment industry was as such—a singer’s fame decided his or her capability. The only time a singer who was not famous could get a chance was in meeting a rich man’s son.
However, Sheng Wenshi had refused to share the video that he had recorded, wanting to keep it a secret. He had only told Ding Chengzhi to wait and see.
Ding Chengzhi had been rather baffled. His time was precious, andWind Pursuerwas in the final stage of filming. He had no time to fool around with Sheng Wenshi.
But when he had followed Sheng Wenshi, the bearded man—Miao Zian—and the rest and arrived at the venue, he had begun to feel something was amiss.

Typically, even when a rich man’s son wanted to gain the favor of others, he would not create such a big scene—just the 40 cars cost more than 30 million yuan. That couldn’t be just to make Li Nianwei happy.
Ding Chengzhi had started to pay attention to this extraordinary concert.

When the first song, “Rolling up the Beaded Curtain,” ended, Ding Chengzhi was deeply shocked in his heart. This was not a song that one would get sick of after listening to it a few times. It was a song worth listening to over and over again.
With the second song, “Lightning Pursuit,” Ding Chengzhi was completely mesmerized.

When the song ended, Ding Chengzhi was taken aback. He stood still for a full minute, then started to tremble. He rushed toward the security officer in the venue. “This is it! This is it! This is what I am looking for! Security, security! I am the music producer for Penghui Films, Ding Chengzhi. Quick, bring me to your boss. I want to meet the person who planned this concert. I want to see him! Now! Right now!”
The crowd was chanting “Li Nianwei” so loudly that it was like an avalanche. The security guard could not hear what Ding Chengzhi was saying. “Mister, what did you say? I can’t hear you!”
Ding Chengzhi anxiously jumped on the spot, shouting. “I am the music producer for Penghui Films, Ding Chengzhi. Quick, bring me to your boss!”

In such a situation, he could not make himself be heard regardless of how much he shouted. The security was puzzled and did not know what was going on. A multitude of feelings surged up, and Ding Chengzhi suddenly had an idea. He held up his fist and punched the security officer.
Then he was surrounded and kicked by a group of security officers, then dragged away...

Hong Dali was enjoying himself, feasting away with his classmates. They ate the best fruits and snacks, played with the most expensive and cutest dogs, and drank the most extravagant beverages, enjoying themselves to the fullest.

The crowd was cheering and listening to the concert when the stadium’s security manager knocked on the door and entered. He bowed to Hong Dali and said, “Young Young Master Dali, there’s a man who claims to be the music producer for Penghui Films. His name is Ding Chengzhi, and he wants to see Young Master Dali.” The security manager had a weird look on his face, as though he was trying hard not to laugh out loud.
Hong Dali shrugged. “Oh, let him come in. Did he say why he was looking for me?”
The security manager helplessly said, “I”m sorry. I’m afraid he can’t come to Young Master Dali. Young Master Dali has to go see him.”
Who is so arrogant? I have to go see him myself?! Hong Dali waved his hand. “No!”

The security manager wiped the sweat off his forehead. “Uh... That is not the case... Mr. Ding Chengzhi accidentally got hurt and is not able to move. He’s lying in the hospital bed now. Hence, you have to go over...”
Hong Dali mumbled. “Oh... Ask him to wait, then. I’m listening to Sister Nianwei sing.”
The security officer had no choice but to leave. “O... okay...”
Music producer of Penghui Films? Hong Dali pouted. “Who is he to be so arrogant? How badly is he injured that he can’t even walk? I have to go see him? So weird...”

While he was pondering, someone knocked on the door again. Hong Dali impatiently responded, “Who is it? Don’t you know I’m happily squandering? Don’t disturb me if it is nothing important. Don’t you know I’m really busy?!”
While he was speaking, the knocking continued. Hong Dali replied troubled, “Xiaoyi, ask him to shut up!”

When Xiaoyi opened the door, a shadow rushed in on crutches. “Are you Young Master Dali? I am the music producer of Penghui Films, Ding Chengzhi. This is my name card! May I know if the singer on the stage, Miss Li Nianwei, is an artist under your company?”
Hong Dali turned around and was amused by what he saw.

This man who claimed to be the music producer for Penghui Films, Mr. Ding Chengzhi, was dusty and dirty all over. His head had dirt all over. His face had been beaten black and blue, his arm was bandaged, and his leg was in a cast. He looked amusing, supporting himself on crutches. Hong Dali’s classmates all roared with laughter. Those who were easily amused were laughing till they were rolling on the floor. Hong Dali almost spat out the water in his mouth. “Uncle, did you come to the wrong studio? What is with your attire?”

“It was to meet you. No matter how much I shouted, the security officer couldn’t hear me. In my anxious state, I punched him.” Ding Chengzhi looked for a chair to sit down. “And I got beaten up by the security officers. But it was okay. After they dragged me out, they heard what I had to say. It was really not easy to finally meet you.”
Hearing that, Hong Dali stared in bewilderment.
This guy punched the security officer and got himself beaten up just to see me? But the security officer is innocent.
At this instant, Hong Dali finally said, “Comrade, you have worked hard!” His classmates roared with laughter once again.

Ding Chengzhi didn’t care about being embarrassed. He grabbed Hong Dali’s arm and started to shake it. He anxiously said, “Young Master Dali, Li Nianwei is the most talented and valuable singer. Definitely the first in my heart! Our company made a movie recently, Wind Pursuer. All we are short of now is a theme song for the movie. After hearing Li Nianwei sing, “Lightning Pursuit” is just the right song. Young Master Dali, would you please sell us a license for this song? Our company is more than willing to pay the licensing fee. As long as you agree, 200,000 yuan will be transferred to you at once!”

Two hundred thousand yuan for the licensing fee for one song was a good price. That was just the licensing fee, not the copyright fee. “Licensing fee” meant that Penghui Films would be able to use the song, but the song would still belong to Li Nianwei. If copyrights for the song were sold, that would mean that even the original author would not be able to use it in the future.
This was the difference between the two fees. Even the world’s top singer could hardly imagine getting 200,000 yuan for the licensing fee for a song.
While his classmates were all shocked by the matter, Hong Dali calmly drank a mouthful of water and said, “No way.”

After hearing Li Nianwei sing, “Lightning Pursuit” is just the right song.
Young Master Dali, would you please sell us a license for this song?
Our company is more than willing to pay the licensing fee.
As long as you agree, 200,000 yuan will be transferred to you at once!”
Two hundred thousand yuan for the licensing fee for one song was a good price.
That was just the licensing fee, not the copyright fee.
“Licensing fee” meant that Penghui Films would be able to use the song, but the song would still belong to Li Nianwei.
If copyrights for the song were sold, that would mean that even the original author would not be able to use it in the future.
This was the difference between the two fees.
Even the world’s top singer could hardly imagine getting 200,000 yuan for the licensing fee for a song.
While his classmates were all shocked by the matter, Hong Dali calmly drank a mouthful of water and said, “No way.”
